functions.name: cmsGetEncodedCMMversion
functions.signature: CMSAPI int CMSEXPORT cmsGetEncodedCMMversion(void);
functions.description: Returns the Little CMS encoded CMM version as an integer (e.g., 2180 for v2.18). Useful for runtime version checks or feature gating.

functions.name: cmsstrcasecmp
functions.signature: CMSAPI int CMSEXPORT cmsstrcasecmp(const char* s1, const char* s2);
functions.description: Case-insensitive string comparison similar to strcasecmp. Returns an integer less than, equal to, or greater than zero depending on lexical order ignoring case.
requirements: s1 must be a valid, NUL-terminated string pointer.
s2 must be a valid, NUL-terminated string pointer.

functions.name: cmsfilelength
functions.signature: CMSAPI long int CMSEXPORT cmsfilelength(FILE* f);
functions.description: Returns the length of the given stream in bytes. Intended as a convenience wrapper over platform I/O to obtain file size.
requirements: f must be a valid FILE* opened by the C runtime.
Behavior on non-seekable streams is unspecified in the header; result may be undefined.

functions.name: cmsCreateContext
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsContext CMSEXPORT cmsCreateContext(void* Plugin, void* UserData);
functions.description: Creates a new lcms context with its own globals and (optionally) an initial plug-in chain and user data. Use separate contexts for thread-safety and isolation.
requirements: Plugin may be NULL or point to a plug-in or a linked list of plug-ins as defined in lcms2_plugin.h.
UserData is an opaque pointer stored in the context; may be NULL.
Returns NULL on failure; caller must check and, on success, eventually call cmsDeleteContext on the returned context.

functions.name: cmsDeleteContext
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsDeleteContext(cmsContext ContextID);
functions.description: Destroys a context previously created by cmsCreateContext/cmsDupContext, releasing associated resources.
requirements: ContextID must be a context previously created by cmsCreateContext or cmsDupContext (or NULL/0 is allowed by comments in header under certain circumstances; passing NULL is accepted in some internal APIs, but not explicitly documented here for this function).
Do not use the context after calling this function.

functions.name: cmsDupContext
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsContext CMSEXPORT cmsDupContext(cmsContext ContextID, void* NewUserData);
functions.description: Duplicates an existing context, inheriting its plug-ins and settings, but allowing different user data.
requirements: ContextID should be a valid context (0 refers to the global context per comments; duplication of global context is allowed by library design).
NewUserData may be NULL or any pointer the caller wishes to associate.
Returns NULL on failure; caller must eventually free the duplicated context with cmsDeleteContext.

functions.name: cmsGetContextUserData
functions.signature: CMSAPI void* CMSEXPORT cmsGetContextUserData(cmsContext ContextID);
functions.description: Retrieves the user data pointer associated with the given context.
requirements: ContextID must be a valid cmsContext.
May return NULL if no user data was set.

functions.name: cmsPlugin
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsPlugin(void* Plugin);
functions.description: Registers one or more plug-ins on the global context. Affects all subsequent operations using the global context (ContextID = 0).
requirements: Plugin must be NULL or point to a cmsPluginBase-derived structure (or linked list) defined in lcms2_plugin.h.
Returns TRUE on success, FALSE on failure.
Global context usage is not recommended for multithreaded apps; prefer cmsPluginTHR per-context.

functions.name: cmsPluginTHR
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsPluginTHR(cmsContext ContextID, void* Plugin);
functions.description: Registers one or more plug-ins on a specific context (thread-safe approach).
requirements: ContextID must be a valid context (not the implicit global unless explicitly intended).
Plugin must be NULL or point to a cmsPluginBase-derived structure (or linked list).
Returns TRUE on success, FALSE on failure.

functions.name: cmsUnregisterPlugins
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsUnregisterPlugins(void);
functions.description: Unregisters all plug-ins from the global context, restoring default behavior.

functions.name: cmsUnregisterPluginsTHR
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsUnregisterPluginsTHR(cmsContext ContextID);
functions.description: Unregisters all plug-ins from the given context, restoring default behavior for that context only.
requirements: ContextID must be a valid context.

functions.name: cmsSetLogErrorHandler
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsSetLogErrorHandler(cmsLogErrorHandlerFunction Fn);
functions.description: Sets a process-wide error logging callback for the global context. The logger receives the context (if available), an error code, and an English message. The logger must not terminate the program.
requirements: Fn may be NULL or a valid function pointer of type cmsLogErrorHandlerFunction.
The callback must not terminate the program and should be reentrant/thread-safe if used in multithreaded code.

functions.name: cmsSetLogErrorHandlerTHR
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsSetLogErrorHandlerTHR(cmsContext ContextID, cmsLogErrorHandlerFunction Fn);
functions.description: Sets an error logging callback for a specific context.
requirements: ContextID must be a valid context.
Fn may be NULL or a valid function pointer of type cmsLogErrorHandlerFunction.
The callback must not terminate the program and should be reentrant/thread-safe if used in multithreaded code.

functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsLab2LCh(cmsCIELCh* LCh, const cmsCIELab* Lab);
functions.description: Converts a color from CIE L*a*b* to CIE L*C*h° (polar form).
requirements: LCh must be a valid pointer to cmsCIELCh.
Lab must be a valid pointer to cmsCIELab.

functions.name: cmsLCh2Lab
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsLCh2Lab(cmsCIELab* Lab, const cmsCIELCh* LCh);
functions.description: Converts a color from CIE L*C*h° to CIE L*a*b*.
requirements: Lab must be a valid pointer to cmsCIELab.
LCh must be a valid pointer to cmsCIELCh.

functions.name: cmsLabEncoded2Float
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsLabEncoded2Float(cmsCIELab* Lab, const cmsUInt16Number wLab[3]);
functions.description: Decodes PCS-encoded Lab (16-bit) values to floating-point CIE L*a*b* (ICC v4 encoding).
requirements: Lab must be a valid pointer to cmsCIELab.
wLab must point to an array of 3 cmsUInt16Number elements.

functions.name: cmsLabEncoded2FloatV2
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsLabEncoded2FloatV2(cmsCIELab* Lab, const cmsUInt16Number wLab[3]);
functions.description: Decodes PCS-encoded Lab (16-bit) values to floating-point CIE L*a*b* using ICC v2 encoding rules.
requirements: Lab must be a valid pointer to cmsCIELab.
wLab must point to an array of 3 cmsUInt16Number elements.

functions.name: cmsFloat2LabEncoded
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsFloat2LabEncoded(cmsUInt16Number wLab[3], const cmsCIELab* Lab);
functions.description: Encodes floating-point CIE L*a*b* values into 16-bit PCS Lab using ICC v4 encoding.
requirements: wLab must point to an array of at least 3 cmsUInt16Number elements.
Lab must be a valid pointer to cmsCIELab.

functions.name: cmsFloat2LabEncodedV2
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsFloat2LabEncodedV2(cmsUInt16Number wLab[3], const cmsCIELab* Lab);
functions.description: Encodes floating-point CIE L*a*b* values into 16-bit PCS Lab using ICC v2 encoding.
requirements: wLab must point to an array of at least 3 cmsUInt16Number elements.
Lab must be a valid pointer to cmsCIELab.

functions.name: cmsXYZEncoded2Float
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsXYZEncoded2Float(cmsCIEXYZ* fxyz, const cmsUInt16Number XYZ[3]);
functions.description: Decodes 16-bit PCS XYZ values into floating-point CIE XYZ (normalized to Y=1.0).
requirements: fxyz must be a valid pointer to cmsCIEXYZ.
XYZ must point to an array of 3 cmsUInt16Number elements.

functions.name: cmsFloat2XYZEncoded
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsFloat2XYZEncoded(cmsUInt16Number XYZ[3], const cmsCIEXYZ* fXYZ);
functions.description: Encodes floating-point CIE XYZ into 16-bit PCS XYZ values (normalized to Y=1.0).
requirements: XYZ must point to an array of at least 3 cmsUInt16Number elements.
fXYZ must be a valid pointer to cmsCIEXYZ.

functions.name: cmsDeltaE
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsFloat64Number CMSEXPORT cmsDeltaE(const cmsCIELab* Lab1, const cmsCIELab* Lab2);
functions.description: Computes the CIE76 ΔE*ab color difference between two Lab colors.
requirements: Lab1 must be a valid pointer to cmsCIELab.
Lab2 must be a valid pointer to cmsCIELab.

functions.name: cmsCIE94DeltaE
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsFloat64Number CMSEXPORT cmsCIE94DeltaE(const cmsCIELab* Lab1, const cmsCIELab* Lab2);
functions.description: Computes the CIE94 ΔE94 color difference between two Lab colors.
requirements: Lab1 must be a valid pointer to cmsCIELab.
Lab2 must be a valid pointer to cmsCIELab.

functions.name: cmsBFDdeltaE
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsFloat64Number CMSEXPORT cmsBFDdeltaE(const cmsCIELab* Lab1, const cmsCIELab* Lab2);
functions.description: Computes the BFD (Bristol) ΔE color difference between two Lab colors.
requirements: Lab1 must be a valid pointer to cmsCIELab.
Lab2 must be a valid pointer to cmsCIELab.

functions.name: cmsCMCdeltaE
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsFloat64Number CMSEXPORT cmsCMCdeltaE(const cmsCIELab* Lab1, const cmsCIELab* Lab2, cmsFloat64Number l, cmsFloat64Number c);
functions.description: Computes the CMC(l:c) color difference between two Lab colors with specified lightness and chroma weights.
requirements: Lab1 must be a valid pointer to cmsCIELab.
Lab2 must be a valid pointer to cmsCIELab.
l should be positive (typical values 1 or 2).
c should be positive (typical value 1).

functions.name: cmsCIE2000DeltaE
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsFloat64Number CMSEXPORT cmsCIE2000DeltaE(const cmsCIELab* Lab1, const cmsCIELab* Lab2, cmsFloat64Number Kl, cmsFloat64Number Kc, cmsFloat64Number Kh);
functions.description: Computes the CIEDE2000 color difference ΔE00 between two Lab colors with user-provided parametric weights Kl, Kc, Kh.
requirements: Lab1 must be a valid pointer to cmsCIELab.
Lab2 must be a valid pointer to cmsCIELab.
Kl, Kc, Kh are typically 1.0; must be finite numbers.

functions.name: cmsWhitePointFromTemp
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsWhitePointFromTemp(cmsCIExyY* WhitePoint, cmsFloat64Number  TempK);
functions.description: Approximates a CIE xyY white point from a correlated color temperature in Kelvin (black body).
requirements: WhitePoint must be a valid pointer to cmsCIExyY.
TempK should be a positive Kelvin temperature in a reasonable range for white points (e.g., ~1000K–25000K).
Returns TRUE on success, FALSE on failure.

functions.name: cmsTempFromWhitePoint
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsTempFromWhitePoint(cmsFloat64Number* TempK, const cmsCIExyY* WhitePoint);
functions.description: Estimates correlated color temperature (Kelvin) from a given CIE xyY white point.
requirements: TempK must be a valid pointer to cmsFloat64Number for the result.
WhitePoint must be a valid pointer to cmsCIExyY.
Returns TRUE on success, FALSE on failure.

functions.name: cmsAdaptToIlluminant
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsAdaptToIlluminant(cmsCIEXYZ* Result, const cmsCIEXYZ* SourceWhitePt, const cmsCIEXYZ* Illuminant, const cmsCIEXYZ* Value);
functions.description: Chromatically adapts a CIE XYZ color Value from SourceWhitePt to a target Illuminant (Bradford-like adaptation internally).
requirements: Result must be a valid pointer to cmsCIEXYZ.
SourceWhitePt must be a valid pointer to cmsCIEXYZ.
Illuminant must be a valid pointer to cmsCIEXYZ.
Value must be a valid pointer to cmsCIEXYZ.
Returns TRUE on success, FALSE on failure.

functions.name: cmsCIECAM02Init
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsHANDLE CMSEXPORT cmsCIECAM02Init(cmsContext ContextID, const cmsViewingConditions* pVC);
functions.description: Initializes a CIECAM02 color appearance model with specified viewing conditions and returns an opaque model handle.
requirements: ContextID may be 0 (global) or a valid cmsContext.
pVC must point to a fully initialized cmsViewingConditions structure (whitePoint, Yb, La, surround, D_value).
Returns NULL on failure; caller must free with cmsCIECAM02Done.

functions.name: cmsCIECAM02Done
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsCIECAM02Done(cmsHANDLE hModel);
functions.description: Releases resources associated with a CIECAM02 model previously created by cmsCIECAM02Init.
requirements: hModel must be a handle returned by cmsCIECAM02Init.
Do not use hModel after this call.

functions.name: cmsCIECAM02Forward
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsCIECAM02Forward(cmsHANDLE hModel, const cmsCIEXYZ* pIn, cmsJCh* pOut);
functions.description: Evaluates the forward CIECAM02 model: converts XYZ to JCh using the initialized model.
requirements: hModel must be a valid handle from cmsCIECAM02Init.
pIn must be a valid pointer to cmsCIEXYZ.
pOut must be a valid pointer to cmsJCh.

functions.name: cmsCIECAM02Reverse
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsCIECAM02Reverse(cmsHANDLE hModel, const cmsJCh* pIn,    cmsCIEXYZ* pOut);
functions.description: Evaluates the reverse CIECAM02 model: converts JCh to XYZ using the initialized model.
requirements: hModel must be a valid handle from cmsCIECAM02Init.
pIn must be a valid pointer to cmsJCh.
pOut must be a valid pointer to cmsCIEXYZ.

functions.name: cmsBuildSegmentedToneCurve
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsToneCurve* CMSEXPORT cmsBuildSegmentedToneCurve(cmsContext ContextID, cmsUInt32Number nSegments, const cmsCurveSegment Segments[]);
functions.description: Builds a tone curve composed of multiple segments (parametric or sampled) and returns an opaque cmsToneCurve.
requirements: ContextID may be 0 or a valid cmsContext.
nSegments must be the number of segments in Segments[].
Segments must point to an array of cmsCurveSegment of length nSegments.
Returns NULL on failure; free with cmsFreeToneCurve.

functions.name: cmsBuildParametricToneCurve
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsToneCurve* CMSEXPORT cmsBuildParametricToneCurve(cmsContext ContextID, cmsInt32Number Type, const cmsFloat64Number Params[]);
functions.description: Builds a parametric tone curve of the given Type using up to 10 parameters, returning an opaque cmsToneCurve.
requirements: ContextID may be 0 or a valid cmsContext.
Type selects the parametric formula; negative types indicate analytically inverted versions per plug-in conventions.
Params must point to the required number of parameters for the given Type.
Returns NULL on failure; free with cmsFreeToneCurve.

functions.name: cmsBuildGamma
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsToneCurve* CMSEXPORT cmsBuildGamma(cmsContext ContextID, cmsFloat64Number Gamma);
functions.description: Builds a simple gamma tone curve (y = x^Gamma) and returns an opaque cmsToneCurve.
requirements: ContextID may be 0 or a valid cmsContext.
Gamma should be a finite, positive number.
Returns NULL on failure; free with cmsFreeToneCurve.

functions.name: cmsBuildTabulatedToneCurve16
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsToneCurve* CMSEXPORT cmsBuildTabulatedToneCurve16(cmsContext ContextID, cmsUInt32Number nEntries, const cmsUInt16Number values[]);
functions.description: Builds a tone curve from a 16-bit lookup table of size nEntries and returns an opaque cmsToneCurve.
requirements: ContextID may be 0 or a valid cmsContext.
values must point to an array of at least nEntries cmsUInt16Number elements.
nEntries must be greater than 0.
Returns NULL on failure; free with cmsFreeToneCurve.

functions.name: cmsBuildTabulatedToneCurveFloat
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsToneCurve* CMSEXPORT cmsBuildTabulatedToneCurveFloat(cmsContext ContextID, cmsUInt32Number nEntries, const cmsFloat32Number values[]);
functions.description: Builds a tone curve from a float lookup table of size nEntries and returns an opaque cmsToneCurve.
requirements: ContextID may be 0 or a valid cmsContext.
values must point to an array of at least nEntries cmsFloat32Number elements.
nEntries must be greater than 0.
Returns NULL on failure; free with cmsFreeToneCurve.

functions.name: cmsFreeToneCurve
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsFreeToneCurve(cmsToneCurve* Curve);
functions.description: Releases resources of a tone curve created by lcms (e.g., cmsBuildGamma, cmsBuildTabulatedToneCurve...).
requirements: Curve may be NULL (no effect) or a pointer returned by lcms tone-curve constructors.
Do not use Curve after free.

functions.name: cmsFreeToneCurveTriple
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsFreeToneCurveTriple(cmsToneCurve* Curve[3]);
functions.description: Frees a triple of tone curves (array of 3 cmsToneCurve*), releasing each and the container if applicable.
requirements: Curve must be a pointer to an array of 3 cmsToneCurve* pointers; each element may be NULL.
After call, individual curves are freed; do not reuse.

functions.name: cmsDupToneCurve
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsToneCurve* CMSEXPORT cmsDupToneCurve(const cmsToneCurve* Src);
functions.description: Creates a deep copy of a tone curve.
requirements: Src must be a valid pointer to cmsToneCurve.
Returns NULL on failure; free the duplicate with cmsFreeToneCurve.

functions.name: cmsReverseToneCurve
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsToneCurve* CMSEXPORT cmsReverseToneCurve(const cmsToneCurve* InGamma);
functions.description: Computes and returns a tone curve that approximates the inverse of the input curve.
requirements: InGamma must be a valid pointer to cmsToneCurve.
Returns NULL on failure; free the result with cmsFreeToneCurve.

functions.name: cmsReverseToneCurveEx
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsToneCurve* CMSEXPORT cmsReverseToneCurveEx(cmsUInt32Number nResultSamples, const cmsToneCurve* InGamma);
functions.description: Computes an inverse tone curve with a specified number of samples, returning a new cmsToneCurve.
requirements: nResultSamples must be greater than 0.
InGamma must be a valid pointer to cmsToneCurve.
Returns NULL on failure; free the result with cmsFreeToneCurve.

functions.name: cmsJoinToneCurve
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsToneCurve* CMSEXPORT cmsJoinToneCurve(cmsContext ContextID, const cmsToneCurve* X,  const cmsToneCurve* Y, cmsUInt32Number nPoints);
functions.description: Joins two tone curves by composition (Y∘X), optionally resampling to nPoints, and returns a new cmsToneCurve.
requirements: ContextID may be 0 or a valid cmsContext.
X must be a valid pointer to cmsToneCurve.
Y must be a valid pointer to cmsToneCurve.
nPoints may control the resolution; must be > 0 if used by implementation.
Returns NULL on failure; free with cmsFreeToneCurve.

functions.name: cmsSmoothToneCurve
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsSmoothToneCurve(cmsToneCurve* Tab, cmsFloat64Number lambda);
functions.description: Smooths a tone curve in place using a regularization parameter lambda. Use to reduce noise/irregularities in a tabulated or multi-segment curve.
requirements: Tab must be a valid cmsToneCurve* obtained from lcms (non-NULL).
lambda should be a non-negative real number (typical smoothing parameter).
On failure returns FALSE; caller should not assume curve was modified.

functions.name: cmsEvalToneCurveFloat
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsFloat32Number CMSEXPORT cmsEvalToneCurveFloat(const cmsToneCurve* Curve, cmsFloat32Number v);
functions.description: Evaluates the given tone curve at floating-point input v, returning the mapped value as float. Use for float-domain tone response evaluation.
requirements: Curve must be a valid, initialized cmsToneCurve* (non-NULL).
v is expected in [0,1] for normalized domain unless using custom curves; out-of-range may be clamped depending on internal curve.
Thread-safe for read-only use of Curve.

functions.name: cmsEvalToneCurve16
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt16Number CMSEXPORT cmsEvalToneCurve16(const cmsToneCurve* Curve, cmsUInt16Number v);
functions.description: Evaluates the tone curve with 16-bit integer input v, returning a 16-bit output. Use for integer-domain tone mapping.
requirements: Curve must be valid and non-NULL.
v range is 0..65535.
Function is read-only on Curve and is reentrant.

functions.name: cmsIsToneCurveMultisegment
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsIsToneCurveMultisegment(const cmsToneCurve* InGamma);
functions.description: Checks whether the tone curve is represented as a multi-segment curve (as opposed to a single parametric or simple table).
requirements: InGamma must be a valid cmsToneCurve pointer.
Returns TRUE if multisegment, FALSE otherwise.

functions.name: cmsIsToneCurveLinear
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsIsToneCurveLinear(const cmsToneCurve* Curve);
functions.description: Returns TRUE if the curve is effectively linear (identity).
requirements: Curve must be a valid pointer.
Definition of linearity is internal; do not assume exact equality.

functions.name: cmsIsToneCurveMonotonic
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsIsToneCurveMonotonic(const cmsToneCurve* t);
functions.description: Returns TRUE if the tone curve is monotonic (non-decreasing or non-increasing depending on encoding).
requirements: t must be valid.
Useful to validate curves before building CLUTs or inverses.

functions.name: cmsIsToneCurveDescending
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsIsToneCurveDescending(const cmsToneCurve* t);
functions.description: Returns TRUE if the curve is strictly/overall descending (e.g., inverse-like).
requirements: t must be valid.
Interpretation is internal; use together with cmsIsToneCurveMonotonic if needed.

functions.name: cmsGetToneCurveParametricType
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsGetToneCurveParametricType(const cmsToneCurve* t);
functions.description: Returns the parametric curve type identifier if the curve is parametric; non-positive or specific codes may indicate non-parametric or inverted variants.
requirements: t must be valid.
Return value meaning follows LittleCMS parametric types; negative values indicate inverted forms.

functions.name: cmsEstimateGamma
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsFloat64Number CMSEXPORT cmsEstimateGamma(const cmsToneCurve* t, cmsFloat64Number Precision);
functions.description: Estimates an equivalent gamma exponent for the given tone curve within the specified precision.
requirements: t must be valid.
Precision should be a small positive real controlling estimation accuracy.
Returns a positive gamma; may return <=0 on failure.

functions.name: cmsGetToneCurveSegment
functions.signature: CMSAPI const cmsCurveSegment* CMSEXPORT cmsGetToneCurveSegment(cmsInt32Number n, const cmsToneCurve* t);
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the nth segment definition of a multi-segment tone curve.
requirements: t must be valid and multi-segment.
n must be within segment index range; otherwise may return NULL.
Returned pointer is owned by lcms; do not modify or free.

functions.name: cmsGetToneCurveEstimatedTableEntries
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsGetToneCurveEstimatedTableEntries(const cmsToneCurve* t);
functions.description: Returns the number of entries in the internally estimated 16-bit lookup table for the curve, if available.
requirements: t must be valid.
If no estimated table exists, count may be zero.

functions.name: cmsGetToneCurveEstimatedTable
functions.signature: CMSAPI const cmsUInt16Number* CMSEXPORT cmsGetToneCurveEstimatedTable(const cmsToneCurve* t);
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the internally estimated 16-bit table for the curve, if available.
requirements: t must be valid.
Use cmsGetToneCurveEstimatedTableEntries to know the length.
Pointer is owned by lcms; read-only; lifetime bound to t.

functions.name: cmsPipelineAlloc
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsPipeline* CMSEXPORT cmsPipelineAlloc(cmsContext ContextID, cmsUInt32Number InputChannels, cmsUInt32Number OutputChannels);
functions.description: Allocates a new processing pipeline (LUT) with given input and output channel counts in the specified context.
requirements: InputChannels and OutputChannels must be >0 and within supported limits.
ContextID may be NULL for global context.
Returns NULL on allocation failure; caller must free with cmsPipelineFree.

functions.name: cmsPipelineFree
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsPipelineFree(cmsPipeline* lut);
functions.description: Frees a pipeline previously allocated or duplicated.
requirements: lut must be a pipeline obtained from lcms or NULL.
After call, lut must not be used.

functions.name: cmsPipelineDup
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsPipeline* CMSEXPORT cmsPipelineDup(const cmsPipeline* Orig);
functions.description: Duplicates an existing pipeline, returning a deep copy.
requirements: Orig must be a valid pipeline pointer.
Returns NULL on failure; free the result with cmsPipelineFree.

functions.name: cmsGetPipelineContextID
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsContext CMSEXPORT cmsGetPipelineContextID(const cmsPipeline* lut);
functions.description: Gets the context associated with the pipeline.
requirements: lut must be valid (non-NULL).
Returns a cmsContext (may be NULL for global context).

functions.name: cmsPipelineInputChannels
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsPipelineInputChannels(const cmsPipeline* lut);
functions.description: Returns the number of input channels of the pipeline.
requirements: lut must be valid.

functions.name: cmsPipelineOutputChannels
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsPipelineOutputChannels(const cmsPipeline* lut);
functions.description: Returns the number of output channels of the pipeline.
requirements: lut must be valid.

functions.name: cmsPipelineStageCount
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsPipelineStageCount(const cmsPipeline* lut);
functions.description: Returns how many stages are in the pipeline.
requirements: lut must be valid.

functions.name: cmsPipelineGetPtrToFirstStage
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsStage* CMSEXPORT cmsPipelineGetPtrToFirstStage(const cmsPipeline* lut);
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the first stage in the pipeline chain, or NULL if empty.
requirements: lut must be valid.
Returned stage is owned by pipeline; do not free directly.

functions.name: cmsPipelineGetPtrToLastStage
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsStage* CMSEXPORT cmsPipelineGetPtrToLastStage(const cmsPipeline* lut);
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the last stage in the pipeline chain, or NULL if empty.
requirements: lut must be valid.
Returned stage is owned by pipeline; do not free directly.

functions.name: cmsPipelineEval16
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsPipelineEval16(const cmsUInt16Number In[], cmsUInt16Number Out[], const cmsPipeline* lut);
functions.description: Evaluates the pipeline on a single 16-bit sample vector, producing 16-bit output.
requirements: In must point to at least cmsPipelineInputChannels(lut) entries; Out to at least cmsPipelineOutputChannels(lut).
lut must be valid and configured appropriately.

functions.name: cmsPipelineEvalFloat
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsPipelineEvalFloat(const cmsFloat32Number In[], cmsFloat32Number Out[], const cmsPipeline* lut);
functions.description: Evaluates the pipeline using floating-point samples, producing floating-point outputs.
requirements: In array length must be >= input channels; Out array length >= output channels.
lut must be valid.

functions.name: cmsPipelineEvalReverseFloat
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsPipelineEvalReverseFloat(cmsFloat32Number Target[], cmsFloat32Number Result[], cmsFloat32Number Hint[], const cmsPipeline* lut);
functions.description: Attempts to invert the pipeline for a given Target output, computing an input Result; Hint may provide initial guess.
requirements: Target and Result must be valid arrays sized to output and input channels respectively.
Hint may be NULL or sized appropriately if provided.
lut must be valid.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsPipelineCat
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsPipelineCat(cmsPipeline* l1, const cmsPipeline* l2);
functions.description: Concatenates pipeline l2 at the end of pipeline l1 (l1 = l2 ∘ l1), if channel counts are compatible.
requirements: l1 and l2 must be valid pipelines.
Output channels of l1 must match input channels of l2 (implied).
Returns FALSE if incompatible or on error.

functions.name: cmsPipelineSetSaveAs8bitsFlag
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsPipelineSetSaveAs8bitsFlag(cmsPipeline* lut, cmsBool On);
functions.description: Sets a flag hinting the pipeline should be saved with 8-bit precision where applicable.
requirements: lut must be valid.
On is TRUE to enable, FALSE to disable.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsPipelineInsertStage
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsPipelineInsertStage(cmsPipeline* lut, cmsStageLoc loc, cmsStage* mpe);
functions.description: Inserts a stage into the pipeline at the beginning or end.
requirements: lut must be valid.
mpe must be a stage allocated by lcms and compatible with the pipeline channel counts.
loc must be cmsAT_BEGIN or cmsAT_END.
On success returns TRUE; ownership of mpe is transferred to pipeline.

functions.name: cmsPipelineUnlinkStage
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsPipelineUnlinkStage(cmsPipeline* lut, cmsStageLoc loc, cmsStage** mpe);
functions.description: Unlinks (removes) and returns a stage from the beginning or end of the pipeline without freeing it.
requirements: lut must be valid.
mpe must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the removed stage pointer (or NULL if none).
Caller becomes responsible to free or reuse the returned stage.

functions.name: cmsPipelineCheckAndRetreiveStages
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsPipelineCheckAndRetreiveStages(const cmsPipeline* Lut, cmsUInt32Number n, ...);
functions.description: Checks the pipeline against an expected sequence of stage types and, if matched, retrieves pointers to those stages via varargs outputs.
requirements: Lut must be valid.
n is the number of expected elements; the variadic list must provide n cmsStageSignature values followed by n cmsStage** outputs.
Returns TRUE and fills outputs on match; otherwise FALSE and leaves outputs untouched.

functions.name: cmsStageAllocIdentity
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsStage* CMSEXPORT cmsStageAllocIdentity(cmsContext ContextID, cmsUInt32Number nChannels);
functions.description: Allocates an identity mapping stage with nChannels (passes inputs to outputs unchanged).
requirements: nChannels > 0.
ContextID may be NULL for global context.
Returns NULL on failure; free with cmsStageFree or by removing from pipeline.

functions.name: cmsStageAllocToneCurves
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsStage* CMSEXPORT cmsStageAllocToneCurves(cmsContext ContextID, cmsUInt32Number nChannels, cmsToneCurve* const Curves[]);
functions.description: Allocates a tone-curves stage applying per-channel cmsToneCurve mappings.
requirements: nChannels > 0.
Curves must be an array of length nChannels with valid cmsToneCurve* entries.
Curves are referenced/owned by the stage after allocation; do not free individually unless documented otherwise.

functions.name: cmsStageAllocMatrix
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsStage* CMSEXPORT cmsStageAllocMatrix(cmsContext ContextID, cmsUInt32Number Rows, cmsUInt32Number Cols, const cmsFloat64Number* Matrix, const cmsFloat64Number* Offset);
functions.description: Allocates a double-precision matrix stage with optional offset (Matrix is Rows x Cols).
requirements: Rows and Cols must match the stage’s input/output channels when inserted.
Matrix must contain Rows*Cols elements; Offset may be NULL or have Rows elements.
ContextID may be NULL.
Returns NULL on failure.

functions.name: cmsStageAllocCLut16bit
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsStage* CMSEXPORT cmsStageAllocCLut16bit(cmsContext ContextID, cmsUInt32Number nGridPoints, cmsUInt32Number inputChan, cmsUInt32Number outputChan, const cmsUInt16Number* Table);
functions.description: Allocates a regular-grid CLUT stage with uniform grid size and 16-bit table values.
requirements: nGridPoints > 1.
inputChan and outputChan > 0.
Table must contain nGridPoints^(inputChan) * outputChan entries and be non-NULL unless creating an empty stage (implementation dependent).
Returns NULL on failure.

functions.name: cmsStageAllocCLutFloat
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsStage* CMSEXPORT cmsStageAllocCLutFloat(cmsContext ContextID, cmsUInt32Number nGridPoints, cmsUInt32Number inputChan, cmsUInt32Number outputChan, const cmsFloat32Number* Table);
functions.description: Allocates a regular-grid CLUT stage with float table values.
requirements: nGridPoints > 1; inputChan, outputChan > 0.
Table size must match nGridPoints^(inputChan) * outputChan floats.
ContextID may be NULL.
Returns NULL on failure.

functions.name: cmsStageAllocCLut16bitGranular
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsStage* CMSEXPORT cmsStageAllocCLut16bitGranular(cmsContext ContextID, const cmsUInt32Number clutPoints[], cmsUInt32Number inputChan, cmsUInt32Number outputChan, const cmsUInt16Number* Table);
functions.description: Allocates a non-uniform (per-dimension) grid CLUT stage with 16-bit table values.
requirements: clutPoints must be an array of length inputChan specifying nodes per dimension, each >1.
Table length must equal (product of clutPoints) * outputChan.
inputChan, outputChan > 0.
Returns NULL on failure.

functions.name: cmsStageAllocCLutFloatGranular
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsStage* CMSEXPORT cmsStageAllocCLutFloatGranular(cmsContext ContextID, const cmsUInt32Number clutPoints[], cmsUInt32Number inputChan, cmsUInt32Number outputChan, const cmsFloat32Number* Table);
functions.description: Allocates a non-uniform per-dimension CLUT stage with float table values.
requirements: clutPoints array length = inputChan, each >1.
Table length = product(clutPoints) * outputChan.
Returns NULL on failure.

functions.name: cmsStageDup
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsStage* CMSEXPORT cmsStageDup(cmsStage* mpe);
functions.description: Duplicates a stage, returning a deep copy.
requirements: mpe must be a valid stage pointer.
Returns NULL on failure; free with cmsStageFree or via pipeline.

functions.name: cmsStageFree
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsStageFree(cmsStage* mpe);
functions.description: Frees a stage previously allocated or duplicated, not owned by a pipeline.
requirements: mpe must not be linked to a pipeline when freed unless API allows.
After freeing, do not reuse.

functions.name: cmsStageNext
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsStage* CMSEXPORT cmsStageNext(const cmsStage* mpe);
functions.description: Returns the next stage in the linked pipeline sequence from the given stage, or NULL if last.
requirements: mpe must be valid and linked to a pipeline (or NULL).
Returned pointer is owned by pipeline.

functions.name: cmsStageInputChannels
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsStageInputChannels(const cmsStage* mpe);
functions.description: Returns the number of input channels for the stage.
requirements: mpe must be valid.

functions.name: cmsStageOutputChannels
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsStageOutputChannels(const cmsStage* mpe);
functions.description: Returns the number of output channels for the stage.
requirements: mpe must be valid.

functions.name: cmsStageType
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsStageSignature CMSEXPORT cmsStageType(const cmsStage* mpe);
functions.description: Returns the stage type signature (e.g., matrix, CLUT, tone curves).
requirements: mpe must be valid.

functions.name: cmsStageData
functions.signature: CMSAPI void* CMSEXPORT cmsStageData(const cmsStage* mpe);
functions.description: Returns an opaque pointer to the stage’s internal data. Intended for inspection; structure is internal.
requirements: mpe must be valid.
Returned pointer type depends on stage; do not modify or free.

functions.name: cmsGetStageContextID
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsContext CMSEXPORT cmsGetStageContextID(const cmsStage* mpe);
functions.description: Gets the context associated with a stage.
requirements: mpe must be valid.

functions.name: cmsStageSampleCLut16bit
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsStageSampleCLut16bit(cmsStage* mpe, cmsSAMPLER16 Sampler, void* Cargo, cmsUInt32Number dwFlags);
functions.description: Iterates/samples a 16-bit CLUT stage with a user callback to inspect or modify entries.
requirements: mpe must be a CLUT stage compatible with 16-bit tables.
Sampler must be a valid function pointer; it may be called many times.
If SAMPLER_INSPECT is not set, sampler may modify CLUT values via Out[].
Cargo is user data pointer (may be NULL).
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsStageSampleCLutFloat
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsStageSampleCLutFloat(cmsStage* mpe, cmsSAMPLERFLOAT Sampler, void* Cargo, cmsUInt32Number dwFlags);
functions.description: Iterates/samples a float CLUT stage using a float sampler callback.
requirements: mpe must be a CLUT stage with float table.
Sampler must be valid; Cargo optional.
Use SAMPLER_INSPECT to prevent writes.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsSliceSpace16
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsSliceSpace16(cmsUInt32Number nInputs, const cmsUInt32Number clutPoints[], cmsSAMPLER16 Sampler, void * Cargo);
functions.description: Generic slicer over an n-dimensional integer grid; calls Sampler on each node.
requirements: nInputs > 0.
clutPoints length must be nInputs; each element > 0 (nodes per dimension).
Sampler must be valid; Cargo optional.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsSliceSpaceFloat
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsSliceSpaceFloat(cmsUInt32Number nInputs, const cmsUInt32Number clutPoints[], cmsSAMPLERFLOAT Sampler, void * Cargo);
functions.description: Generic slicer over an n-dimensional float grid; calls Sampler on each node.
requirements: nInputs > 0; clutPoints length nInputs; each > 0.
Sampler must be valid.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsMLUalloc
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsMLU* CMSEXPORT cmsMLUalloc(cmsContext ContextID, cmsUInt32Number nItems);
functions.description: Allocates an MLU (multi-localized Unicode) container capable of holding up to nItems entries.
requirements: nItems >= 0 (capacity hint).
ContextID may be NULL.
Returns NULL on failure; free with cmsMLUfree.

functions.name: cmsMLUfree
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsMLUfree(cmsMLU* mlu);
functions.description: Frees an MLU previously allocated or duplicated.
requirements: mlu may be NULL; otherwise must be owned by caller.
After freeing, do not reuse.

functions.name: cmsMLUdup
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsMLU* CMSEXPORT cmsMLUdup(const cmsMLU* mlu);
functions.description: Duplicates an MLU object.
requirements: mlu must be a valid MLU pointer.
Returns NULL on failure; free result with cmsMLUfree.

functions.name: cmsMLUsetASCII
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsMLUsetASCII(cmsMLU* mlu, const char LanguageCode[3], const char CountryCode[3], const char* ASCIIString);
functions.description: Sets an ASCII string entry for the given language and country codes into the MLU.
requirements: mlu must be valid.
LanguageCode and CountryCode must be 2-letter codes plus terminating null (3-sized arrays).
ASCIIString must be a valid null-terminated string.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsMLUsetWide
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsMLUsetWide(cmsMLU* mlu, const char LanguageCode[3], const char CountryCode[3], const wchar_t* WideString);
functions.description: Sets a wide-character string entry for the given locale.
requirements: mlu must be valid.
LanguageCode/CountryCode as above.
WideString must be a valid null-terminated wide string.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsMLUsetUTF8
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsMLUsetUTF8(cmsMLU* mlu, const char LanguageCode[3], const char CountryCode[3], const char* UTF8String);
functions.description: Sets a UTF-8 string entry for the given locale.
requirements: mlu must be valid.
LanguageCode/CountryCode 2-char codes (+NUL).
UTF8String must be valid UTF-8 and null-terminated.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsMLUgetASCII
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsMLUgetASCII(const cmsMLU* mlu, const char LanguageCode[3], const char CountryCode[3], char* Buffer, cmsUInt32Number BufferSize);
functions.description: Retrieves an entry as ASCII into Buffer. Returns number of bytes written or needed.
requirements: mlu must be valid.
LanguageCode/CountryCode may be special codes (e.g., cmsNoLanguage).
If Buffer is NULL or BufferSize too small, returned value indicates required size.
Buffer must have at least BufferSize bytes.

functions.name: cmsMLUgetWide
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsMLUgetWide(const cmsMLU* mlu, const char LanguageCode[3], const char CountryCode[3], wchar_t* Buffer, cmsUInt32Number BufferSize);
functions.description: Retrieves an entry as wide characters. Returns count like cmsMLUgetASCII.
requirements: mlu must be valid.
Buffer may be NULL to query size.
BufferSize is in wchar_t units (implementation-dependent).

functions.name: cmsMLUgetUTF8
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsMLUgetUTF8(const cmsMLU* mlu, const char LanguageCode[3], const char CountryCode[3], char* Buffer, cmsUInt32Number BufferSize);
functions.description: Retrieves an entry as UTF-8 into Buffer. Returns bytes written/needed.
requirements: mlu must be valid.
Buffer may be NULL to get required size.

functions.name: cmsMLUgetTranslation
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsMLUgetTranslation(const cmsMLU* mlu, const char LanguageCode[3], const char CountryCode[3], char ObtainedLanguage[3], char ObtainedCountry[3]);
functions.description: Finds the best available translation matching requested Language/Country and returns actual codes found.
requirements: mlu must be valid.
ObtainedLanguage and ObtainedCountry must be 3-byte arrays to receive 2-letter codes + NUL.
Returns TRUE if a match is found.

functions.name: cmsMLUtranslationsCount
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsMLUtranslationsCount(const cmsMLU* mlu);
functions.description: Returns the number of (language,country) translations stored in the MLU.
requirements: mlu must be valid.

functions.name: cmsMLUtranslationsCodes
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsMLUtranslationsCodes(const cmsMLU* mlu, cmsUInt32Number idx, char LanguageCode[3], char CountryCode[3]);
functions.description: Retrieves the language and country codes at the given index.
requirements: mlu must be valid.
idx must be < cmsMLUtranslationsCount(mlu).
LanguageCode and CountryCode must be 3-byte arrays for results.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsAllocNamedColorList
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsNAMEDCOLORLIST* CMSEXPORT cmsAllocNamedColorList(cmsContext ContextID, cmsUInt32Number n, cmsUInt32Number ColorantCount, const char* Prefix, const char* Suffix);
functions.description: Allocates a named color list with capacity n and a given ColorantCount; optional common Prefix/Suffix for names.
requirements: ColorantCount <= cmsMAXCHANNELS.
ContextID may be NULL.
Prefix/Suffix may be NULL.
Returns NULL on failure; free with cmsFreeNamedColorList.

functions.name: cmsFreeNamedColorList
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsFreeNamedColorList(cmsNAMEDCOLORLIST* v);
functions.description: Frees a named color list.
requirements: v may be NULL; otherwise must be owned by caller.
After call, v cannot be used.

functions.name: cmsDupNamedColorList
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsNAMEDCOLORLIST* CMSEXPORT cmsDupNamedColorList(const cmsNAMEDCOLORLIST* v);
functions.description: Duplicates a named color list.
requirements: v must be valid.
Returns NULL on failure; free with cmsFreeNamedColorList.

functions.name: cmsAppendNamedColor
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsAppendNamedColor(cmsNAMEDCOLORLIST* v, const char* Name, cmsUInt16Number PCS[3], cmsUInt16Number Colorant[cmsMAXCHANNELS]);
functions.description: Appends a named color with its PCS (Lab/XYZ encoded) and device colorant values.
requirements: v must be valid.
Name must be non-NULL and reasonably sized.
PCS must have 3 16-bit entries.
Colorant array must have at least ColorantCount entries as defined for v.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsNamedColorCount
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsNamedColorCount(const cmsNAMEDCOLORLIST* v);
functions.description: Returns the number of named colors stored.
requirements: v must be valid.

functions.name: cmsNamedColorIndex
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsNamedColorIndex(const cmsNAMEDCOLORLIST* v, const char* Name);
functions.description: Finds the index of a named color by its name, or -1 if not found.
requirements: v must be valid.
Name must be non-NULL.

functions.name: cmsNamedColorInfo
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsNamedColorInfo(const cmsNAMEDCOLORLIST* NamedColorList, cmsUInt32Number nColor, char* Name, char* Prefix, char* Suffix, cmsUInt16Number* PCS, cmsUInt16Number* Colorant);
functions.description: Retrieves information about a named color at index nColor; any output parameter may be NULL to skip.
requirements: NamedColorList must be valid.
nColor must be < cmsNamedColorCount(NamedColorList).
Name/Prefix/Suffix buffers must be large enough (sizes not specified by header).
PCS points to 3 entries; Colorant must have ColorantCount entries.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsGetNamedColorList
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsNAMEDCOLORLIST* CMSEXPORT cmsGetNamedColorList(cmsHTRANSFORM xform);
functions.description: Retrieves the named color list associated with a transform, if any.
requirements: xform must be a valid cmsHTRANSFORM.
May return NULL if not a named-color transform.

functions.name: cmsAllocProfileSequenceDescription
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsSEQ* CMSEXPORT cmsAllocProfileSequenceDescription(cmsContext ContextID, cmsUInt32Number n);
functions.description: Allocates a profile sequence descriptor structure capable of holding n elements.
requirements: ContextID may be NULL.
n is the number of sequence entries to allocate.
Returns NULL on failure; free with cmsFreeProfileSequenceDescription.

functions.name: cmsDupProfileSequenceDescription
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsSEQ* CMSEXPORT cmsDupProfileSequenceDescription(const cmsSEQ* pseq);
functions.description: Duplicates a profile sequence description.
requirements: pseq must be valid.
Returns NULL on failure; free with cmsFreeProfileSequenceDescription.

functions.name: cmsFreeProfileSequenceDescription
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsFreeProfileSequenceDescription(cmsSEQ* pseq);
functions.description: Frees a profile sequence description.
requirements: pseq may be NULL; otherwise must be owned by caller.

functions.name: cmsDictAlloc
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsHANDLE CMSEXPORT cmsDictAlloc(cmsContext ContextID);
functions.description: Allocates a metadata dictionary (key/value pairs with localized display names/values).
requirements: ContextID may be NULL.
Returns NULL on failure; free with cmsDictFree.

functions.name: cmsDictFree
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsDictFree(cmsHANDLE hDict);
functions.description: Frees a dictionary handle.
requirements: hDict may be NULL; otherwise must be a valid handle returned by lcms.

functions.name: cmsDictDup
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsHANDLE CMSEXPORT cmsDictDup(cmsHANDLE hDict);
functions.description: Duplicates a dictionary.
requirements: hDict must be valid.
Returns NULL on failure; free with cmsDictFree.

functions.name: cmsDictAddEntry
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsDictAddEntry(cmsHANDLE hDict, const wchar_t* Name, const wchar_t* Value, const cmsMLU *DisplayName, const cmsMLU *DisplayValue);
functions.description: Adds an entry to the dictionary with internal Name/Value and optional localized display name/value.
requirements: hDict must be valid.
Name and Value must be non-NULL wide strings.
DisplayName/DisplayValue may be NULL.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsDictGetEntryList
functions.signature: CMSAPI const cmsDICTentry* CMSEXPORT cmsDictGetEntryList(cmsHANDLE hDict);
functions.description: Returns the head of the dictionary entry linked list for enumeration.
requirements: hDict must be valid.
Returned list nodes are owned by dictionary; do not modify/free.

functions.name: cmsDictNextEntry
functions.signature: CMSAPI const cmsDICTentry* CMSEXPORT cmsDictNextEntry(const cmsDICTentry* e);
functions.description: Returns the next entry in the dictionary list, or NULL at end.
requirements: e must be a valid entry pointer obtained from cmsDictGetEntryList or previous call.

functions.name: cmsCreateProfilePlaceholder
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsHPROFILE CMSEXPORT cmsCreateProfilePlaceholder(cmsContext ContextID);
functions.description: Creates an empty profile object placeholder in the given context, to be populated by writes.
requirements: ContextID may be NULL.
Returns NULL on failure; close with cmsCloseProfile when done.

functions.name: cmsGetProfileContextID
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsContext CMSEXPORT cmsGetProfileContextID(cmsHPROFILE hProfile);
functions.description: Gets the context associated with the profile.
requirements: hProfile must be valid.

functions.name: cmsGetTagCount
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsGetTagCount(cmsHPROFILE hProfile);
functions.description: Returns the number of tags in the profile, or negative on error.
requirements: hProfile must be valid.

functions.name: cmsGetTagSignature
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsTagSignature CMSEXPORT cmsGetTagSignature(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsUInt32Number n);
functions.description: Returns the tag signature at index n.
requirements: hProfile must be valid.
n must be less than cmsGetTagCount(hProfile).

functions.name: cmsIsTag
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsIsTag(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsTagSignature sig);
functions.description: Checks if a tag with the given signature exists in the profile.
requirements: hProfile must be valid.
Returns TRUE if present.

functions.name: cmsReadTag
functions.signature: CMSAPI void* CMSEXPORT cmsReadTag(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsTagSignature sig);
functions.description: Reads and parses a tag into a pre-formatted in-memory structure and returns a pointer to it.
requirements: hProfile must be valid.
sig must be a valid tag signature present in the profile.
Returned pointer type depends on tag type; ownership is by lcms (read-only) unless documented otherwise.

functions.name: cmsWriteTag
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsWriteTag(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsTagSignature sig, const void* data);
functions.description: Writes a pre-formatted tag structure into the profile under the given signature.
requirements: hProfile must be valid and open for writing.
data must point to a valid structure appropriate for the tag signature.
Overwriting existing tags is allowed as per lcms rules.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsLinkTag
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsLinkTag(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsTagSignature sig, cmsTagSignature dest);
functions.description: Creates a link so that tag sig references the data of another tag dest.
requirements: hProfile must be valid.
dest must exist; sig will be linked to dest.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsTagLinkedTo
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsTagSignature CMSEXPORT cmsTagLinkedTo(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsTagSignature sig);
functions.description: If tag sig is linked to another tag, returns the destination tag signature; otherwise returns the tag itself or 0.
requirements: hProfile must be valid.

functions.name: cmsReadRawTag
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsReadRawTag(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsTagSignature sig, void* Buffer, cmsUInt32Number BufferSize);
functions.description: Reads raw, unparsed tag data into Buffer. Returns bytes read or required.
requirements: hProfile must be valid.
If Buffer is NULL or BufferSize too small, function returns needed size without reading.
Buffer must be large enough and writable.

functions.name: cmsWriteRawTag
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsWriteRawTag(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsTagSignature sig, const void* data, cmsUInt32Number Size);
functions.description: Writes raw tag data to the profile.
requirements: hProfile must be valid and writable.
data must point to Size bytes.
sig must be valid for raw write in this context.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsGetHeaderFlags
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsGetHeaderFlags(cmsHPROFILE hProfile);
functions.description: Returns the profile header flags field.
requirements: hProfile must be valid.

functions.name: cmsGetHeaderAttributes
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsGetHeaderAttributes(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsUInt64Number* Flags);
functions.description: Retrieves the 64-bit device attributes from the profile header into Flags.
requirements: hProfile must be valid.
Flags must be non-NULL.

functions.name: cmsGetHeaderProfileID
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsGetHeaderProfileID(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsUInt8Number* ProfileID);
functions.description: Retrieves the 16-byte profile ID (MD5) into ProfileID.
requirements: hProfile must be valid.
ProfileID must point to at least 16 bytes.

functions.name: cmsGetHeaderCreationDateTime
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsGetHeaderCreationDateTime(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, struct tm *Dest);
functions.description: Retrieves the profile creation date/time into Dest.
requirements: hProfile must be valid.
Dest must be non-NULL.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsGetHeaderRenderingIntent
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsGetHeaderRenderingIntent(cmsHPROFILE hProfile);
functions.description: Returns the rendering intent from the profile header.
requirements: hProfile must be valid.

functions.name: cmsSetHeaderFlags
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsSetHeaderFlags(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsUInt32Number Flags);
functions.description: Sets the profile header flags field.
requirements: hProfile must be valid and opened for editing/writing.

functions.name: cmsGetHeaderManufacturer
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsGetHeaderManufacturer(cmsHPROFILE hProfile);
functions.description: Gets the 4-byte device manufacturer signature.
requirements: hProfile must be valid.

functions.name: cmsSetHeaderManufacturer
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsSetHeaderManufacturer(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsUInt32Number manufacturer);
functions.description: Sets the manufacturer signature in the header.
requirements: hProfile must be valid and writable.

functions.name: cmsGetHeaderCreator
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsGetHeaderCreator(cmsHPROFILE hProfile);
functions.description: Gets the profile creator signature.
requirements: hProfile must be valid.

functions.name: cmsGetHeaderModel
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsGetHeaderModel(cmsHPROFILE hProfile);
functions.description: Gets the device model signature.
requirements: hProfile must be valid.

functions.name: cmsSetHeaderModel
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsSetHeaderModel(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsUInt32Number model);
functions.description: Sets the device model signature in the header.
requirements: hProfile must be valid and writable.

functions.name: cmsSetHeaderAttributes
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsSetHeaderAttributes(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsUInt64Number Flags);
functions.description: Sets the 64-bit device attributes in the header.
requirements: hProfile must be valid and writable.

functions.name: cmsSetHeaderProfileID
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsSetHeaderProfileID(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsUInt8Number* ProfileID);
functions.description: Sets the 16-byte profile ID in the header.
requirements: hProfile must be valid and writable.
ProfileID must point to 16 bytes.

functions.name: cmsSetHeaderRenderingIntent
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsSetHeaderRenderingIntent(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsUInt32Number RenderingIntent);
functions.description: Sets the rendering intent value in the profile header.
requirements: hProfile must be valid and writable.
RenderingIntent must be one of the standard or supported intent codes.

functions.name: cmsGetPCS
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsColorSpaceSignature CMSEXPORT cmsGetPCS(cmsHPROFILE hProfile);
functions.description: Returns the PCS (Profile Connection Space) signature (XYZ or Lab).
requirements: hProfile must be valid.

functions.name: cmsSetPCS
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsSetPCS(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsColorSpaceSignature pcs);
functions.description: Sets the PCS in the profile header.
requirements: hProfile must be valid and writable.
pcs should be cmsSigXYZData or cmsSigLabData (per ICC).

functions.name: cmsGetColorSpace
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsColorSpaceSignature CMSEXPORT cmsGetColorSpace(cmsHPROFILE hProfile);
functions.description: Returns the profile's data color space signature.
requirements: hProfile must be valid.

functions.name: cmsSetColorSpace
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsSetColorSpace(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsColorSpaceSignature sig);
functions.description: Sets the profile's data color space signature.
requirements: hProfile must be valid and writable.
sig must be a valid cmsColorSpaceSignature.

functions.name: cmsGetDeviceClass
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsProfileClassSignature CMSEXPORT cmsGetDeviceClass(cmsHPROFILE hProfile);
functions.description: Returns the profile class signature (input, display, output, link, etc.).
requirements: hProfile must be valid.

functions.name: cmsSetDeviceClass
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsSetDeviceClass(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsProfileClassSignature sig);
functions.description: Sets the profile class signature.
requirements: hProfile must be valid and writable.

functions.name: cmsSetProfileVersion
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsSetProfileVersion(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsFloat64Number Version);
functions.description: Sets the ICC profile version (e.g., 2.1, 4.3).
requirements: hProfile must be valid and writable.
Version must be a supported ICC version.

functions.name: cmsGetProfileVersion
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsFloat64Number CMSEXPORT cmsGetProfileVersion(cmsHPROFILE hProfile);
functions.description: Gets the ICC profile version as a floating-point value.
requirements: hProfile must be valid.

functions.name: cmsGetEncodedICCversion
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsGetEncodedICCversion(cmsHPROFILE hProfile);
functions.description: Gets the raw encoded ICC version field from the header.
requirements: hProfile must be valid.

functions.name: cmsSetEncodedICCversion
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsSetEncodedICCversion(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsUInt32Number Version);
functions.description: Sets the raw encoded ICC version field in the header.
requirements: hProfile must be valid and writable.
Version must be encoded per ICC (e.g., 0x04300000 for 4.3).

functions.name: cmsIsIntentSupported
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsIsIntentSupported(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsUInt32Number Intent, cmsUInt32Number UsedDirection);
functions.description: Checks if the profile supports a given rendering intent in the given direction (input/output/proof).
requirements: hProfile must be valid.
Intent must be a supported code.
UsedDirection must be one of LCMS_USED_AS_* constants.

functions.name: cmsIsMatrixShaper
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsIsMatrixShaper(cmsHPROFILE hProfile);
functions.description: Returns TRUE if the profile can be represented as a matrix + shaper (simple type).
requirements: hProfile must be valid.

functions.name: cmsIsCLUT
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsIsCLUT(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsUInt32Number Intent, cmsUInt32Number UsedDirection);
functions.description: Returns TRUE if the profile contains a CLUT for the given intent/direction.
requirements: hProfile must be valid.
Intent and UsedDirection as per cmsIsIntentSupported.

functions.name: _cmsICCcolorSpace
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsColorSpaceSignature CMSEXPORT _cmsICCcolorSpace(int OurNotation);
functions.description: Internal helper mapping LittleCMS PT_* pixel type code to ICC color space signature.

functions.name: cmsOpenIOhandlerFromNULL

functions.name: cmsCloseIOhandler

functions.name: cmsMD5computeID

functions.name: cmsOpenProfileFromStreamTHR

functions.description: Context-aware variant for opening from a FILE* stream.

functions.name: cmsOpenProfileFromIOhandler2THR

functions.name: cmsCloseProfile

requirements: hProfile may be NULL; otherwise must be a valid profile handle.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsSaveProfileToFile
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsSaveProfileToFile(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, const char* FileName);
functions.description: Saves the profile content to a file path.
requirements: hProfile must be valid.
FileName must be a valid path; directories must exist.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsSaveProfileToStream

functions.description: Saves the profile to a FILE* stream.
requirements: hProfile must be valid.

Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsSaveProfileToMem

functions.description: Saves the profile to an IO handler. Returns number of bytes written.
requirements: hProfile and io must be valid.
io must be opened for writing.

functions.name: cmsCreateRGBProfileTHR

functions.name: cmsCreateRGBProfile

dwFlags may include cmsFLAGS_* for devicelink creation.

functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsGetSupportedIntents(cmsUInt32Number nMax, cmsUInt32Number* Codes, char** Descriptions);

requirements: Codes and Descriptions may be NULL to only query count.

Returns number of intents possibly <= nMax.

dwFlags may include cmsFLAGS_* control flags.

functions.name: cmsCreateTransform
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsHTRANSFORM CMSEXPORT cmsCreateTransform(cmsHPROFILE Input, cmsUInt32Number InputFormat, cmsHPROFILE Output, cmsUInt32Number OutputFormat, cmsUInt32Number Intent, cmsUInt32Number dwFlags);

requirements: As per cmsCreateTransformTHR.

functions.name: cmsCreateProofingTransform

functions.name: cmsDeleteTransform

functions.description: Deletes a transform and frees resources.
requirements: hTransform may be NULL; otherwise must be a valid handle from lcms.

Buffers may alias only if formats and transform support it (not guaranteed).

functions.name: cmsDoTransformStride
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsDoTransformStride(cmsHTRANSFORM Transform, const void * InputBuffer, void * OutputBuffer, cmsUInt32Number Size, cmsUInt32Number Stride);

requirements: Transform must be valid.

functions.description: Applies the transform to a 2D image with explicit per-line and per-plane strides.
requirements: Transform must be valid.
Input/OutputBuffer must reference sufficient memory for PixelsPerLine * LineCount according to the given stride parameters.
Stride values must be consistent with selected formats (planar vs chunky).

functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsGetTransformOutputFormat(cmsHTRANSFORM hTransform);
functions.description: Returns the TYPE_* pixel format for the transform output.
requirements: hTransform must be valid.

functions.name: cmsChangeBuffersFormat
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsChangeBuffersFormat(cmsHTRANSFORM hTransform, cmsUInt32Number InputFormat, cmsUInt32Number OutputFormat);
functions.description: Changes the input/output buffer formats associated with the transform (backwards compatibility).
requirements: hTransform must be valid.
InputFormat/OutputFormat must be valid TYPE_* codes compatible with the profiles.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsGetPostScriptColorResource
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsGetPostScriptColorResource(cmsContext ContextID, cmsPSResourceType Type, cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsUInt32Number Intent, cmsUInt32Number dwFlags, cmsIOHANDLER* io);
