hProfile and io must be valid.
Intent and dwFlags must be supported.

functions.name: cmsGetPostScriptCSA
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsGetPostScriptCSA(cmsContext ContextID, cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsUInt32Number Intent, cmsUInt32Number dwFlags, void* Buffer, cmsUInt32Number dwBufferLen);
functions.description: Writes a PostScript Color Space Array (CSA) to Buffer; returns bytes written or needed.
requirements: hProfile must be valid.
Buffer may be NULL to query required size (dwBufferLen ignored then).
ContextID may be NULL.

functions.name: cmsGetPostScriptCRD
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsGetPostScriptCRD(cmsContext ContextID, cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsUInt32Number Intent, cmsUInt32Number dwFlags, void* Buffer, cmsUInt32Number dwBufferLen);
functions.description: Writes a PostScript Color Rendering Dictionary (CRD) to Buffer; returns bytes written or needed.
requirements: As per cmsGetPostScriptCSA.

functions.name: cmsIT8Alloc
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsHANDLE CMSEXPORT cmsIT8Alloc(cmsContext ContextID);
functions.description: Allocates an IT8/CGATS dataset object.
requirements: ContextID may be NULL.
Returns NULL on failure; free with cmsIT8Free.

functions.name: cmsIT8Free
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsIT8Free(cmsHANDLE hIT8);
functions.description: Frees an IT8 handle.
requirements: hIT8 may be NULL; otherwise must be an IT8 handle from lcms.

functions.name: cmsIT8TableCount
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsIT8TableCount(cmsHANDLE hIT8);
functions.description: Returns the number of tables in the IT8 dataset.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.

functions.name: cmsIT8SetTable
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsIT8SetTable(cmsHANDLE hIT8, cmsUInt32Number nTable);
functions.description: Selects the current table by index. Returns non-negative on success or negative on error.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
nTable must be < cmsIT8TableCount(hIT8).

functions.name: cmsIT8LoadFromFile
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsHANDLE CMSEXPORT cmsIT8LoadFromFile(cmsContext ContextID, const char* cFileName);
functions.description: Loads an IT8/CGATS dataset from a file path.
requirements: cFileName must be a readable file.
ContextID may be NULL.
Returns NULL on failure.

functions.name: cmsIT8LoadFromMem
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsHANDLE CMSEXPORT cmsIT8LoadFromMem(cmsContext ContextID, const void *Ptr, cmsUInt32Number len);
functions.description: Loads an IT8 dataset from a memory buffer.
requirements: Ptr must point to len bytes representing a valid CGATS/IT8 file.
Returns NULL on failure.

functions.name: cmsIT8SaveToFile
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsIT8SaveToFile(cmsHANDLE hIT8, const char* cFileName);
functions.description: Saves the IT8 dataset to a file.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
cFileName must be writable path.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsIT8SaveToMem
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsIT8SaveToMem(cmsHANDLE hIT8, void *MemPtr, cmsUInt32Number* BytesNeeded);
functions.description: Serializes the dataset to memory; if MemPtr is NULL, returns required size in BytesNeeded.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
BytesNeeded must be non-NULL.
If MemPtr provided, it must point to buffer of at least *BytesNeeded bytes.

functions.name: cmsIT8GetSheetType
functions.signature: CMSAPI const char* CMSEXPORT cmsIT8GetSheetType(cmsHANDLE hIT8);
functions.description: Returns the sheet type string of the dataset.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
Returned string is owned by lcms; read-only.

functions.name: cmsIT8SetSheetType
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsIT8SetSheetType(cmsHANDLE hIT8, const char* Type);
functions.description: Sets the sheet type string.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
Type must be a null-terminated string.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsIT8SetComment
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsIT8SetComment(cmsHANDLE hIT8, const char* cComment);
functions.description: Adds or sets a comment string in the dataset.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
cComment must be a string.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsIT8SetPropertyStr
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsIT8SetPropertyStr(cmsHANDLE hIT8, const char* cProp, const char *Str);
functions.description: Sets a string property (keyword) in the dataset header.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
cProp and Str must be strings.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsIT8SetPropertyDbl
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsIT8SetPropertyDbl(cmsHANDLE hIT8, const char* cProp, cmsFloat64Number Val);
functions.description: Sets a numeric property in the dataset header.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
cProp must be a string.

functions.name: cmsIT8SetPropertyHex
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsIT8SetPropertyHex(cmsHANDLE hIT8, const char* cProp, cmsUInt32Number Val);
functions.description: Sets a hexadecimal numeric property in the dataset header.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
cProp must be a string.

functions.name: cmsIT8SetPropertyMulti
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsIT8SetPropertyMulti(cmsHANDLE hIT8, const char* Key, const char* SubKey, const char *Buffer);
functions.description: Sets a multi-valued property with key/subkey.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
Key, SubKey, Buffer must be strings.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsIT8SetPropertyUncooked
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsIT8SetPropertyUncooked(cmsHANDLE hIT8, const char* Key, const char* Buffer);
functions.description: Sets a raw property value without parsing or validation.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
Key and Buffer must be strings.

functions.name: cmsIT8GetProperty
functions.signature: CMSAPI const char* CMSEXPORT cmsIT8GetProperty(cmsHANDLE hIT8, const char* cProp);
functions.description: Gets a property string by key from the dataset header.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
cProp must be a string key.
Returned pointer is owned by lcms; may be NULL if not found.

functions.name: cmsIT8GetPropertyDbl
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsFloat64Number CMSEXPORT cmsIT8GetPropertyDbl(cmsHANDLE hIT8, const char* cProp);
functions.description: Gets a property as a double; returns 0 or NaN on failure (implementation-dependent).
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
cProp must be a string key.

functions.name: cmsIT8GetPropertyMulti
functions.signature: CMSAPI const char* CMSEXPORT cmsIT8GetPropertyMulti(cmsHANDLE hIT8, const char* Key, const char *SubKey);
functions.description: Gets a subkey property string.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
Key/SubKey must be strings.

functions.name: cmsIT8EnumProperties
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsIT8EnumProperties(cmsHANDLE hIT8, char ***PropertyNames);
functions.description: Enumerates property keys, returning count and filling PropertyNames with an array of strings.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
PropertyNames must be a pointer to receive array; ownership/lifetime per implementation (likely allocated by lcms).

functions.name: cmsIT8EnumPropertyMulti
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsUInt32Number CMSEXPORT cmsIT8EnumPropertyMulti(cmsHANDLE hIT8, const char* cProp, const char ***SubpropertyNames);
functions.description: Enumerates subproperty names for a given property key.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
cProp must be a string key.
SubpropertyNames must be a pointer to receive array.

functions.name: cmsIT8GetDataRowCol
functions.signature: CMSAPI const char* CMSEXPORT cmsIT8GetDataRowCol(cmsHANDLE hIT8, int row, int col);
functions.description: Gets a cell value by row/column as string.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
row and col must be within the table bounds.
Returned pointer is owned by lcms; may be NULL.

functions.name: cmsIT8GetDataRowColDbl
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsFloat64Number CMSEXPORT cmsIT8GetDataRowColDbl(cmsHANDLE hIT8, int row, int col);
functions.description: Gets a cell value by row/column as double.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
row and col in range.

functions.name: cmsIT8SetDataRowCol
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsIT8SetDataRowCol(cmsHANDLE hIT8, int row, int col, const char* Val);
functions.description: Sets a cell string value by row/column.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
row and col must be valid indices.
Val must be a string.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsIT8SetDataRowColDbl
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsIT8SetDataRowColDbl(cmsHANDLE hIT8, int row, int col, cmsFloat64Number Val);
functions.description: Sets a cell numeric value by row/column.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
Indices must be valid.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsIT8GetData
functions.signature: CMSAPI const char* CMSEXPORT cmsIT8GetData(cmsHANDLE hIT8, const char* cPatch, const char* cSample);
functions.description: Gets a datum by patch name and sample name.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
cPatch and cSample must be strings.
Returns pointer or NULL if not found.

functions.name: cmsIT8GetDataDbl
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsFloat64Number CMSEXPORT cmsIT8GetDataDbl(cmsHANDLE hIT8, const char* cPatch, const char* cSample);
functions.description: Gets a datum by patch/sample as double.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
Keys must exist.

functions.name: cmsIT8SetData
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsIT8SetData(cmsHANDLE hIT8, const char* cPatch, const char* cSample, const char *Val);
functions.description: Sets a string value for a patch/sample pair.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
cPatch, cSample, Val must be strings.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsIT8SetDataDbl
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsIT8SetDataDbl(cmsHANDLE hIT8, const char* cPatch, const char* cSample, cmsFloat64Number Val);
functions.description: Sets a numeric value for a patch/sample pair.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
Keys must be valid.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsIT8FindDataFormat
functions.signature: CMSAPI int CMSEXPORT cmsIT8FindDataFormat(cmsHANDLE hIT8, const char* cSample);
functions.description: Finds the column index for the given sample name, or negative if not found.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
cSample must be a string.

functions.name: cmsIT8SetDataFormat
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsIT8SetDataFormat(cmsHANDLE hIT8, int n, const char *Sample);
functions.description: Sets the sample name for column n.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
n must be a valid column index.
Sample must be a string.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsIT8EnumDataFormat
functions.signature: CMSAPI int CMSEXPORT cmsIT8EnumDataFormat(cmsHANDLE hIT8, char ***SampleNames);
functions.description: Enumerates sample (column) names; returns count or negative on error.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
SampleNames must be a pointer to receive array (allocated by lcms).

functions.name: cmsIT8GetPatchName
functions.signature: CMSAPI const char* CMSEXPORT cmsIT8GetPatchName(cmsHANDLE hIT8, int nPatch, char* buffer);
functions.description: Gets the patch name at index nPatch, optionally copying into buffer.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
nPatch must be in range.
buffer may be NULL; size requirements not specified.

functions.name: cmsIT8GetPatchByName
functions.signature: CMSAPI int CMSEXPORT cmsIT8GetPatchByName(cmsHANDLE hIT8, const char *cPatch);
functions.description: Finds a patch index by its name; returns index or negative if not found.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
cPatch must be a string.

functions.name: cmsIT8SetTableByLabel
functions.signature: CMSAPI int CMSEXPORT cmsIT8SetTableByLabel(cmsHANDLE hIT8, const char* cSet, const char* cField, const char* ExpectedType);
functions.description: Selects a table by matching label and field names; returns non-negative on success or negative on error.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
cSet, cField, ExpectedType must be strings (ExpectedType may be NULL depending on usage).

functions.name: cmsIT8SetIndexColumn
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsIT8SetIndexColumn(cmsHANDLE hIT8, const char* cSample);
functions.description: Sets which column acts as the index (key) column.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
cSample must be the name of an existing column.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsIT8DefineDblFormat
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsIT8DefineDblFormat(cmsHANDLE hIT8, const char* Formatter);
functions.description: Sets the numeric formatting string used when writing doubles in the dataset.
requirements: hIT8 must be valid.
Formatter must be a valid printf-like format for doubles (e.g., "%.6f").

functions.name: cmsGBDAlloc
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsHANDLE CMSEXPORT cmsGBDAlloc(cmsContext ContextID);
functions.description: Allocates a gamut boundary description (GBD) accumulator object.
requirements: ContextID may be NULL.
Returns NULL on failure; free with cmsGBDFree.

functions.name: cmsGBDFree
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsGBDFree(cmsHANDLE hGBD);
functions.description: Frees a GBD handle.
requirements: hGBD may be NULL; otherwise must be valid.

functions.name: cmsGDBAddPoint
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsGDBAddPoint(cmsHANDLE hGBD, const cmsCIELab* Lab);
functions.description: Adds a Lab point to the gamut dataset.
requirements: hGBD must be valid.
Lab must be non-NULL.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsGDBCompute
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsGDBCompute(cmsHANDLE  hGDB, cmsUInt32Number dwFlags);
functions.description: Computes the gamut boundary from the accumulated points.
requirements: hGDB must be valid.
dwFlags may alter computation; specifics not in header.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsGDBCheckPoint
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsGDBCheckPoint(cmsHANDLE hGBD, const cmsCIELab* Lab);
functions.description: Checks whether a Lab point is inside the computed gamut boundary.
requirements: hGBD must be valid and computed.
Lab must be non-NULL.
Returns TRUE if inside (or per implementation).

functions.name: cmsDetectBlackPoint
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsDetectBlackPoint(cmsCIEXYZ* BlackPoint, cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsUInt32Number Intent, cmsUInt32Number dwFlags);
functions.description: Estimates the source profile black point in XYZ and writes it to BlackPoint.
requirements: BlackPoint must be non-NULL.
hProfile must be valid.
Intent must be supported; dwFlags may influence detection.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: cmsDetectDestinationBlackPoint
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsDetectDestinationBlackPoint(cmsCIEXYZ* BlackPoint, cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsUInt32Number Intent, cmsUInt32Number dwFlags);
functions.description: Estimates the destination profile black point in XYZ.
requirements: As per cmsDetectBlackPoint.

functions.name: cmsDetectTAC
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsFloat64Number CMSEXPORT cmsDetectTAC(cmsHPROFILE hProfile);
functions.description: Estimates the total area coverage (maximum ink sum) for a profile.
requirements: hProfile must be valid.
Returns a numeric value (units not specified here).

functions.name: cmsDetectRGBProfileGamma
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsFloat64Number CMSEXPORT cmsDetectRGBProfileGamma(cmsHPROFILE hProfile, cmsFloat64Number threshold);
functions.description: Estimates the gamma of an RGB profile's TRCs, returning a positive gamma or -1 on error.
requirements: hProfile must be valid and RGB.
threshold is a positive real controlling detection sensitivity.

functions.name: cmsDesaturateLab
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT cmsDesaturateLab(cmsCIELab* Lab, double amax, double amin, double bmax, double bmin);
functions.description: Clamps/desaturates a Lab color by restricting a and b components to given min/max ranges.
requirements: Lab must be non-NULL and will be modified in place.
Range parameters define allowed a/b ranges; amin <= amax and bmin <= bmax.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: _cmsVEC3init
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT _cmsVEC3init(cmsVEC3* r, cmsFloat64Number x, cmsFloat64Number y, cmsFloat64Number z);
functions.description: Initializes a 3D vector r with components (x,y,z).
requirements: r must be non-NULL.

functions.name: _cmsVEC3minus
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT _cmsVEC3minus(cmsVEC3* r, const cmsVEC3* a, const cmsVEC3* b);
functions.description: Computes r = a - b for 3D vectors.
requirements: r, a, b must be non-NULL.

functions.name: _cmsVEC3cross
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT _cmsVEC3cross(cmsVEC3* r, const cmsVEC3* u, const cmsVEC3* v);
functions.description: Computes r = u × v (cross product).
requirements: r, u, v must be non-NULL.

functions.name: _cmsVEC3dot
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsFloat64Number CMSEXPORT _cmsVEC3dot(const cmsVEC3* u, const cmsVEC3* v);
functions.description: Returns the dot product u·v.
requirements: u and v must be non-NULL.

functions.name: _cmsVEC3length
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsFloat64Number CMSEXPORT _cmsVEC3length(const cmsVEC3* a);
functions.description: Returns the Euclidean length of vector a.
requirements: a must be non-NULL.

functions.name: _cmsVEC3distance
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsFloat64Number CMSEXPORT _cmsVEC3distance(const cmsVEC3* a, const cmsVEC3* b);
functions.description: Returns the Euclidean distance between vectors a and b.
requirements: a and b must be non-NULL.

functions.name: _cmsMAT3identity
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT _cmsMAT3identity(cmsMAT3* a);
functions.description: Sets matrix a to identity.
requirements: a must be non-NULL.

functions.name: _cmsMAT3isIdentity
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT _cmsMAT3isIdentity(const cmsMAT3* a);
functions.description: Returns TRUE if matrix a is identity within internal tolerance.
requirements: a must be non-NULL.

functions.name: _cmsMAT3per
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT _cmsMAT3per(cmsMAT3* r, const cmsMAT3* a, const cmsMAT3* b);
functions.description: Computes r = a × b (matrix product).
requirements: r, a, b must be non-NULL.

functions.name: _cmsMAT3inverse
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT _cmsMAT3inverse(const cmsMAT3* a, cmsMAT3* b);
functions.description: Computes inverse of a into b. Returns TRUE on success.
requirements: a and b must be non-NULL.
Matrix a must be invertible.

functions.name: _cmsMAT3solve
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT _cmsMAT3solve(cmsVEC3* x, cmsMAT3* a, cmsVEC3* b);
functions.description: Solves the linear system a·x = b for x. Returns TRUE on success.
requirements: x, a, b must be non-NULL.
a must be invertible.

functions.name: _cmsMAT3eval
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT _cmsMAT3eval(cmsVEC3* r, const cmsMAT3* a, const cmsVEC3* v);
functions.description: Evaluates r = a·v.
requirements: r, a, v must be non-NULL.

functions.name: cmsMD5alloc
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsHANDLE CMSEXPORT cmsMD5alloc(cmsContext ContextID);
functions.description: Allocates an MD5 state handle for incremental hashing in the given context.
requirements: ContextID may be NULL.
Returns NULL on failure; free by cmsMD5finish (which closes) or a dedicated free (not exposed here).

functions.name: cmsMD5add
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsMD5add(cmsHANDLE Handle, const cmsUInt8Number* buf, cmsUInt32Number len);
functions.description: Accumulates len bytes from buf into the MD5 state.

buf must be non-NULL if len>0.

functions.name: cmsMD5finish
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT cmsMD5finish(cmsProfileID* ProfileID, cmsHANDLE Handle);
functions.description: Finalizes the MD5 computation, writing the 16-byte digest into ProfileID and releasing Handle.

Handle must be a valid MD5 handle.
After call, Handle must not be used.

functions.name: cmsSignalError
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT  cmsSignalError(cmsContext ContextID, cmsUInt32Number ErrorCode, const char *ErrorText, ...);
functions.description: Reports an error or warning through the lcms error logging mechanism using a printf-style message.
requirements: ContextID may be NULL.
ErrorCode should be one of cmsERROR_* codes.
ErrorText must be a printf-style format string followed by matching varargs.

functions.name: _cmsMalloc
functions.signature: CMSAPI void* CMSEXPORT _cmsMalloc(cmsContext ContextID, cmsUInt32Number size);
functions.description: Allocates size bytes in the given context using lcms memory handlers.
requirements: size > 0.
Returns NULL on failure; free with _cmsFree.

functions.name: _cmsMallocZero
functions.signature: CMSAPI void* CMSEXPORT _cmsMallocZero(cmsContext ContextID, cmsUInt32Number size);
functions.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory of size bytes in the given context.
requirements: size > 0.
Returns NULL on failure; free with _cmsFree.

functions.name: _cmsCalloc
functions.signature: CMSAPI void* CMSEXPORT _cmsCalloc(cmsContext ContextID, cmsUInt32Number num, cmsUInt32Number size);
functions.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory for an array of num elements of size bytes.
requirements: num and size such that num*size does not overflow.
Returns NULL on failure; free with _cmsFree.

functions.name: _cmsRealloc
functions.signature: CMSAPI void* CMSEXPORT _cmsRealloc(cmsContext ContextID, void* Ptr, cmsUInt32Number NewSize);
functions.description: Reallocates a memory block to NewSize bytes.
requirements: Ptr may be NULL (equivalent to _cmsMalloc).
NewSize may be 0 (implementation-defined behavior).
Returns new pointer or NULL on failure.
Use _cmsFree to free.

functions.name: _cmsFree
functions.signature: CMSAPI void CMSEXPORT _cmsFree(cmsContext ContextID, void* Ptr);
functions.description: Frees memory previously allocated by lcms memory functions.
requirements: Ptr may be NULL.
Ptr must have been allocated with lcms allocators in the same context.

functions.name: _cmsDupMem
functions.signature: CMSAPI void* CMSEXPORT _cmsDupMem(cmsContext ContextID, const void* Org, cmsUInt32Number size);
functions.description: Duplicates a memory block of size bytes.
requirements: Org must be non-NULL if size>0.
Returns NULL on failure; free with _cmsFree.

functions.description: Adjusts 32-bit endianness (byte swap) as needed.

functions.description: Reads an unsigned 16-bit integer from io (big-endian ICC) into n.
requirements: io and n must be valid.
Returns TRUE on success.

functions.name: _cmsReadUInt32Number
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT  _cmsReadUInt32Number(cmsIOHANDLER* io, cmsUInt32Number* n);
functions.description: Reads a 32-bit unsigned integer from io into n.
requirements: io and n must be valid.

functions.name: _cmsReadFloat32Number
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT  _cmsReadFloat32Number(cmsIOHANDLER* io, cmsFloat32Number* n);
functions.description: Reads a 32-bit IEEE float from io into n.
requirements: io and n must be valid.

functions.name: _cmsReadUInt64Number
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT  _cmsReadUInt64Number(cmsIOHANDLER* io, cmsUInt64Number* n);
functions.description: Reads a 64-bit unsigned integer from io into n.
requirements: io and n must be valid.

functions.name: _cmsRead15Fixed16Number
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT  _cmsRead15Fixed16Number(cmsIOHANDLER* io, cmsFloat64Number* n);
functions.description: Reads an ICC s15Fixed16Number from io and converts to double, storing in n.
requirements: io and n must be valid.

functions.name: _cmsReadXYZNumber
functions.signature: CMSAPI cmsBool CMSEXPORT  _cmsReadXYZNumber(cmsIOHANDLER* io, cmsCIEXYZ* XYZ);
functions.description: Reads an ICC encoded XYZ triplet and converts to cmsCIEXYZ.
requirements: io and XYZ must be valid.

import random
import string
from typing import List

# This generator targets generic C strings consumed by various lcms2 fuzzer stubs.
# Strategy:
# - Produce a corpus entry that concatenates several NUL-terminated C strings and a few
#   numeric blobs, since the harness pulls FUZZ_PARAM_STR multiple times and may also
#   fetch integers/floats from the same underlying buffer. Many stubs only require
#   valid, NUL-terminated text with typical ICC/IT8 tokens.
# - Include common keywords (IT8 fields, language/country codes, known tag names),
#   mixed with random ASCII and length-varied segments to exercise different code paths.
# - Keep everything valid (no embedded NUL inside a C string segment), then separate
#   strings with a single NUL. The fuzzer infra will slice these as needed.
# - Append an aligned tail of random 32-bit and 64-bit values to satisfy FUZZ_PARAM of
#   numeric types when present.

SAFE_ASCII = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + " _-+/.:,;#()[]{}@!$%&*?=\'\""

ICC_WORDS = [
    # Common language/country codes, tags, and IT8 tokens
    "en", "US", "GB", "de", "FR", "es", "JP", "CN",
    "DATA", "SAMPLE_ID", "KEY", "VAL", "NUM", "HEX", "RAW",
    "P0", "P1", "P2", "P3", "S0", "S1", "S2", "S3",
    "type", "comment",
    # Named color related
    "Red", "Green", "Blue", "Cyan", "Magenta", "Yellow", "Black",
    # ICC tag names (a subset useful for lookups/printing)
    "desc", "cprt", "wtpt", "bkpt", "rTRC", "gTRC", "bTRC", "rXYZ", "gXYZ", "bXYZ",
    "chad", "vcgt", "tech", "dmnd", "dmdd",
]

# Utility to build a single C-string without NULs
def make_c_string(rng: random.Random, min_len: int, max_len: int, bias_words: List[str]) -> bytes:
    # With some probability choose a biased known word or composition of them
    choice = rng.random()
    if bias_words and choice < 0.5:
        # 50%: choose 1-3 known tokens and join with safe separators
        parts = []
        for _ in range(1 + (0 if rng.random() < 0.6 else 1) + (0 if rng.random() < 0.7 else 1)):
            parts.append(rng.choice(bias_words))
        sep = rng.choice([" ", "_", "-", ":", "/"])
        s = sep.join(parts)
    else:
        # 50%: random ASCII
        n = rng.randint(min_len, max_len)
        s = "".join(rng.choice(SAFE_ASCII) for _ in range(n))
    # Ensure non-empty occasionally for APIs that require it, but allow empty sometimes
    if len(s) == 0 and rng.random() < 0.8:
        s = rng.choice(bias_words or ["x"]) or "x"
    return s.encode("ascii", errors="ignore") + b"\x00"

# Emit a pack of strings
def build_string_pack(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    out = bytearray()
    # Create a diverse set of strings: identifiers, values, labels
    count = rng.randint(8, 20)
    for i in range(count):
        # Vary lengths to cover short and longer cases
        if i < 6:
            b = make_c_string(rng, 1, 8, ICC_WORDS)
        elif i < 12:
            b = make_c_string(rng, 3, 24, ICC_WORDS)
        else:
            b = make_c_string(rng, 0, 64, ICC_WORDS)
        out.extend(b)
    return bytes(out)

# Emit aligned numeric blob for FUZZ_PARAM(cmsUInt32Number/cmsInt32Number/cmsFloat64Number)
# Keep values varied but finite.
import struct

def build_numeric_tail(rng: random.Random, budget: int) -> bytes:
    out = bytearray()
    # Produce a mix of 32-bit ints and 64-bit doubles
    patterns_u32 = [0, 1, 2, 3, 10, 16, 255, 256, 1023, 4096, 65535, 0xFFFFFFFF]
    patterns_i32 = [0, -1, 1, -2, 2, 127, -128, 32767, -32768, 2147483647, -2147483648]
    patterns_f64 = [0.0, 1.0, -1.0, 0.5, 2.0, 10.0, 100.0, 1e-6, 1e6, 3.1415926535, float(0.0)]

    # Add some randoms too
    def rand_u32():
        return rng.getrandbits(32)
    def rand_i32():
        return rng.randint(-2**31, 2**31 - 1)
    def rand_f64():
        # Keep finite
        return rng.uniform(-1e9, 1e9)

    emitters = []
    for v in patterns_u32 + [rand_u32() for _ in range(8)]:
        emitters.append((4, lambda x=v: struct.pack('<I', x)))
    for v in patterns_i32 + [rand_i32() for _ in range(8)]:
        emitters.append((4, lambda x=v: struct.pack('<i', x)))
    for v in patterns_f64 + [rand_f64() for _ in range(8)]:
        emitters.append((8, lambda x=v: struct.pack('<d', x)))

    rng.shuffle(emitters)
    for size, fn in emitters:
        if len(out) + size > budget:
            break
        out.extend(fn())
    return bytes(out)

def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:

    kv_extra = []

    remaining_budget = max(0, 4096 - (len(strings) + len(extra)))
    nums = build_numeric_tail(rng, remaining_budget)

    buf = strings + extra + nums
    # Trim just in case
    return buf[:4096]

ASCII_WORDS = [
    "desc", "profile", "icc", "sRGB", "Display", "Printer", "Camera",
    "Résumé", "naïve", "coöperate", "façade", "Über", "Straße", "Mañana",

    "إدارة الألوان", "ألوان",
    "颜色", "色彩", "描述",

]

EMOJI = [
    "😀", "👍", "🎨", "🖨️", "📷", "🖥️", "🌈", "✨", "⚙️", "🧪"
]

# A set of interesting Unicode ranges encoded via code point lists to ensure valid UTF-8:
RANGES = [
    (0x0020, 0x007E),   # printable ASCII
    (0x00A0, 0x00FF),   # Latin-1 supplement
    (0x0100, 0x017F),   # Latin Extended-A
    (0x0400, 0x04FF),   # Cyrillic
    (0x0370, 0x03FF),   # Greek
    (0x0530, 0x058F),   # Armenian
    (0x3040, 0x309F),   # Hiragana
    (0x30A0, 0x30FF),   # Katakana
    (0x4E00, 0x9FFF),   # CJK Unified Ideographs
]

def _rand_cp(rng, rnd):
    a, b = rng
    return rnd.randint(a, b)

def _make_random_word(rnd, min_len=3, max_len=16):
    length = rnd.randint(min_len, max_len)
    # Ensure valid UTF-8 by composing from valid code points, avoiding surrogates and NUL
    cps = []
    for _ in range(length):
        rng = rnd.choice(RANGES)
        cp = _rand_cp(rng, rnd)
        # Avoid control chars and zero
        if cp == 0 or (cp < 0x20 and cp not in (0x09, 0x0A, 0x0D)):
            cp = 0x20
        cps.append(cp)
    return ''.join(chr(cp) for cp in cps)

def _with_variations(base: str, rnd: random.Random) -> str:
    parts = [base]
    # Optionally prepend/append language or metadata-like snippets
    if rnd.random() < 0.5:
        parts.insert(0, rnd.choice(["en_US", "fr_FR", "de_DE", "ja_JP", "zh_CN"]))
    if rnd.random() < 0.5:
        parts.append(rnd.choice(EMOJI))
    if rnd.random() < 0.4:
        parts.append(rnd.choice([" v2", " v4.3", " gamma 2.2", " D65"]))
    if rnd.random() < 0.3:
        parts.append(" – ")
        parts.append(_make_random_word(rnd, 3, 8))
    sep = rnd.choice([" ", " - ", ": ", " | "])
    s = sep.join(parts)
    # Ensure no embedded NULs and keep length reasonable
    s = s.replace("\x00", " ")
    # Truncate to keep under 4096 bytes once encoded
    encoded = s.encode('utf-8', errors='strict')
    if len(encoded) > 4000:
        # Try to clamp by characters to stay below limit
        # Approximate: keep a fraction of chars
        keep = max(1, int(len(s) * 4000 / len(encoded)))
        s = s[:keep]
    return s

def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rnd = random.Random(seed)

    # Choose a base strategy
    strategy = rnd.random()

    if strategy < 0.25:
        # Simple ASCII/Latin word
        s = rnd.choice(ASCII_WORDS)
        # Maybe add an emoji or number
        if rnd.random() < 0.6:
            s += rnd.choice([" ", " - ", ": "]) + rnd.choice(EMOJI)
        if rnd.random() < 0.6:
            s += " " + str(rnd.randint(1, 100))
    elif strategy < 0.50:
        # Compose multiple known words
        n = rnd.randint(2, 5)
        s = " ".join(rnd.choice(ASCII_WORDS) for _ in range(n))
        s = _with_variations(s, rnd)
    elif strategy < 0.75:
        # Random multilingual word
        s = _make_random_word(rnd, 6, 24)
        s = _with_variations(s, rnd)
    else:
        # Mixed: known word + random block
        s = rnd.choice(ASCII_WORDS)
        s = s + " " + _make_random_word(rnd, 4, 12)
        s = _with_variations(s, rnd)

    # Ensure strict UTF-8 and reasonable size
    b = s.encode('utf-8', errors='strict')
    if len(b) > 4096:
        b = b[:4096]
        # Avoid cutting in middle of a multi-byte sequence; backtrack to valid boundary
        # Find last valid decoding point
        i = len(b)
        while i > 0:
            try:
                b[:i].decode('utf-8')
                b = b[:i]
                break
            except UnicodeDecodeError:
                i -= 1
        if i == 0:
            # Fallback to simple ASCII
            b = b"desc"

    # Do not include a trailing NUL; the fuzzer harness passes C-strings with implicit NUL.
    # Return bytes buffer <= 4096
    return b

import os
import random
import struct
from typing import List

# This generator produces valid files for several consumers in the target stubs:
# - cmsfilelength / cmsOpenIOhandlerFromFile / cmsOpenIOhandlerFromStream: any bytes are fine
# - cmsCreateDeviceLinkFromCubeFile / THR: prefers valid-ish .cube LUT text files
# - cmsIT8LoadFromFile: prefers valid-ish IT8/CGATS formatted text tables
# The fuzzer infrastructure will place the returned bytes into a file and pass the filename.
# We therefore choose among a few plausible formats and emit syntactically valid content.
# Size limited to <= 4096 bytes.

MAX_SIZE = 4096


def _rand(seed: int) -> random.Random:
    return random.Random(seed)


def _random_ascii(r: random.Random, length_range=(3, 12)) -> str:
    n = r.randint(*length_range)
    # Safe characters for tokens
    alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_-'    
    return ''.join(r.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(n))


def _emit_binary_blob(r: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Create an arbitrary binary blob with some structure: header + random chunks
    # Header magic + length
    chunks: List[bytes] = []
    magic = b'FZBL'  # synthetic magic
    # choose total size between 32 and 2048
    total = r.randint(32, min(2048, MAX_SIZE))
    # number of chunks
    n_chunks = r.randint(1, 8)
    header = magic + struct.pack('>H', n_chunks) + b'\x00\x01'  # version 1
    chunks.append(header)
    remaining = total - len(header)
    for i in range(n_chunks):
        if remaining <= 6:
            break
        # type id
        t = r.choice([b'DATA', b'TEXT', b'ZLIB', b'NULL', b'RAW\0'])
        # payload size (bounded)
        max_pl = max(0, min(remaining - 6, r.randint(4, 256)))
        pl = r.randint(0, max_pl)
        payload = r.randbytes(pl)
        # chunk: 4-byte type + 2-byte len + data
        chunk = t[:4] + struct.pack('>H', pl) + payload
        chunks.append(chunk)
        remaining -= len(chunk)
    blob = b''.join(chunks)
    # pad to total with random bytes
    if len(blob) < total:
        blob += r.randbytes(total - len(blob))
    return blob[:MAX_SIZE]


def _emit_cube_file(r: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Generate a valid-ish .cube LUT file per common Blackmagic/IRIDAS .cube format
    # Reference: simple header keywords and a 1D or 3D LUT with normalized float entries
    lines: List[str] = []
    title = _random_ascii(r)
    lines.append(f"TITLE \"{title}\"")
    # Domain
    if r.random() < 0.7:
        dmin = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
        dmax = [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]
        # Occasionally tweak domain
        if r.random() < 0.3:
            dmin = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
            dmax = [r.choice([0.8, 1.0, 1.2]), r.choice([0.8, 1.0, 1.2]), r.choice([0.8, 1.0, 1.2])]
        lines.append("DOMAIN_MIN {:.6f} {:.6f} {:.6f}".format(*dmin))
        lines.append("DOMAIN_MAX {:.6f} {:.6f} {:.6f}".format(*dmax))
    # comments
    for _ in range(r.randint(0, 3)):
        lines.append(f"# {_random_ascii(r, (5,15))} {r.randint(0,9999)}")

    is_3d = r.random() < 0.7
    if is_3d:
        size = r.choice([2, 3, 4, 17]) if r.random() < 0.5 else r.randint(2, 9)
        lines.append(f"LUT_3D_SIZE {size}")
        # generate entries in z-fastest order commonly seen; any order usually accepted
        for b in range(size):
            for g in range(size):
                for rch in range(size):
                    # normalized floats 0..1
                    rr = (rch / (size - 1))
                    gg = (g / (size - 1))
                    bb = (b / (size - 1))
                    # jitter slightly
                    j = 1e-3
                    rr = min(1.0, max(0.0, rr + r.uniform(-j, j)))
                    gg = min(1.0, max(0.0, gg + r.uniform(-j, j)))
                    bb = min(1.0, max(0.0, bb + r.uniform(-j, j)))
                    lines.append("{:.6f} {:.6f} {:.6f}".format(rr, gg, bb))
    else:
        size = r.choice([2, 3, 16, 33, 1024]) if r.random() < 0.6 else r.randint(2, 64)
        lines.append(f"LUT_1D_SIZE {size}")
        for i in range(size):
            t = i / (size - 1)
            # simple gamma curve
            gamma = r.choice([1.0, 2.2, 2.4, 1.8])
            val = pow(t, 1.0 / gamma)
            rj = min(1.0, max(0.0, val + r.uniform(-1e-3, 1e-3)))
            gj = min(1.0, max(0.0, val + r.uniform(-1e-3, 1e-3)))
            bj = min(1.0, max(0.0, val + r.uniform(-1e-3, 1e-3)))
            lines.append("{:.6f} {:.6f} {:.6f}".format(rj, gj, bj))

    text = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
    b = text.encode('ascii', errors='strict')
    return b[:MAX_SIZE]


def _emit_it8_cgats(r: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Generate a valid-ish IT8/CGATS file structure accepted by cmsIT8LoadFromFile
    # Minimal sections with keyword=value, BEGIN_DATA_FORMAT, BEGIN_DATA
    lines: List[str] = []
    lines.append("CGATS.17")
    lines.append("ORIGINATOR \"FuzzGen\"")
    lines.append("DESCRIPTOR \"Test Chart\"")
    # Common keywords
    lines.append("NUMBER_OF_FIELDS 6")
    lines.append("NUMBER_OF_SETS {}".format(r.choice([12, 24, 48, 96])))
    lines.append("MEASUREMENT_SOURCE SPECTRO")
    lines.append("INSTRUMENT i1Pro2")
    lines.append("COLOR_REP XYZ")
    # Define fields
    fields = ["SAMPLE_ID", "XYZ_X", "XYZ_Y", "XYZ_Z", "RGB_R", "RGB_G"]
    lines.append("BEGIN_DATA_FORMAT")
    lines.append(" ".join(fields))
    lines.append("END_DATA_FORMAT")
    # Data
    nsets = int(lines[4].split()[1])
    lines.append("BEGIN_DATA")
    for i in range(1, nsets + 1):
        sid = f"P{i:03d}"
        # simple mapping from RGB to XYZ-like values
        r8 = r.randint(0, 255)
        g8 = r.randint(0, 255)
        b8 = r.randint(0, 255)
        # normalize roughly to 0..100 range for XYZ
        X = 0.4124 * (r8/255) + 0.3576 * (g8/255) + 0.1805 * (b8/255)
        Y = 0.2126 * (r8/255) + 0.7152 * (g8/255) + 0.0722 * (b8/255)
        Z = 0.0193 * (r8/255) + 0.1192 * (g8/255) + 0.9505 * (b8/255)
        # Scale to 0..100
        X *= 100.0; Y *= 100.0; Z *= 100.0
        line = f"{sid} {X:.4f} {Y:.4f} {Z:.4f} {r8} {g8}"
        lines.append(line)
        # keep file bounded
        if sum(len(s)+1 for s in lines) > MAX_SIZE - 64:
            nsets = i
            break
    lines.append("END_DATA")
    text = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
    b = text.encode('ascii', errors='strict')
    return b[:MAX_SIZE]


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    r = _rand(seed)
    # Choose a target-friendly format with weighted probabilities:
    # Favor .cube and IT8 to exercise deeper parsers; still emit binaries sometimes.
    choice = r.choices(
        population=["cube", "it8", "binary"],
        weights=[0.45, 0.35, 0.20],
        k=1,
    )[0]
    if choice == "cube":
        return _emit_cube_file(r)
    elif choice == "it8":
        return _emit_it8_cgats(r)
    else:
        return _emit_binary_blob(r)

import random
import struct
import zlib

# This generator focuses on producing valid/interesting byte buffers for Little CMS entry points that
# read in-memory data:
# - cmsOpenIOhandlerFromMem: accepts any non-empty bytes (acts like a readable memory stream)
# - cmsOpenProfileFromMem / THR: expect valid ICC profile blobs (v2/v4). We'll craft minimal ICC headers
#   with basic required fields and a small tag table (e.g., desc, wtpt) using correct sizes/offsets and
#   expected tag type blocks.
# - cmsIT8LoadFromMem: expects IT8.7/2 ASCII tables; we generate a syntactically valid small IT8 dataset.
# - cmsMD5add and _cmsDupMem accept arbitrary bytes as well.
#
# Strategy:
# - With seeded randomness, choose between: ICC profile blob, IT8 dataset, or arbitrary content.
# - ICC profiles: construct a minimal but valid ICC v2 profile with header (128 bytes), tag table with 1-3 tags,
#   and well-formed tag data blocks (descType, wtpt XYZ, textType). Keep total size <= 4096.
# - IT8 datasets: generate a small valid IT8.7/2 file with headers and a small data table.
# - Fallbacks: random printable text, zero-filled, patterned, or compressed-like data to exercise IO.
#
# All outputs are within 4096 bytes and self-consistent where applicable.

ICC_MAGIC = 0x61637370  # 'acsp'

# Helper: big-endian packers

def be32(x):
    return struct.pack('>I', x & 0xFFFFFFFF)

def be16(x):
    return struct.pack('>H', x & 0xFFFF)

def be_s15f16(d):
    # Clamp to S15.16 range and encode signed 15.16 fixed
    # Typical XYZ values ~0..2; keep within [-32768, 32767.9999]
    val = max(min(d, 32767.0), -32768.0)
    n = int(round(val * (1 << 16)))
    return struct.pack('>i', n)


def pad4(b: bytes) -> bytes:
    pad = (-len(b)) & 3
    if pad:
        b += b'\x00' * pad
    return b


def make_desc_tag(text: str) -> bytes:
    # 'desc' type (textDescriptionType) for v2: type signature 'desc', reserved, ASCII length, string, null,
    # Unicode and ScriptCode parts follow; keep minimal valid with zero-length for extras.
    # Structure:
    # 0: type sig (4) = 'desc'
    # 4: reserved (4) = 0
    # 8: ASCII length (4) N (including null?) ICC spec: count of bytes for the string (not including null), but
    # many implementations include a trailing null char. We'll include N and N bytes plus a terminating 0.
    ascii_bytes = text.encode('ascii', 'ignore')
    N = len(ascii_bytes)
    body = b'desc' + b'\x00\x00\x00\x00' + be32(N) + ascii_bytes + b'\x00'
    # Unicode code count (4), Unicode bytes (2*count), ScriptCode code (2), ScriptCode count (1), ScriptCode bytes (count)
    body += be32(0)  # no unicode
    body += be16(0)  # ScriptCode code
    body += b'\x00'  # ScriptCode count
    # one padding byte to align? We'll rely on pad4 at the end.
    return pad4(body)


def make_text_tag(text: str) -> bytes:
    # 'text' type (textType): 'text' + reserved + 7-bit ASCII text (no trailing NUL mandated)
    data = text.encode('ascii', 'ignore')
    body = b'text' + b'\x00\x00\x00\x00' + data
    return pad4(body)


def make_wtpt_tag(x=0.9642, y=1.0, z=0.8249) -> bytes:
    # XYZType: 'XYZ ' + reserved + XYZNumber array (S15Fixed16 for X,Y,Z)
    body = b'XYZ ' + b'\x00\x00\x00\x00'
    body += be_s15f16(x) + be_s15f16(y) + be_s15f16(z)
    return pad4(body)


def make_cicp_tag(prim=1, trc=1, matrix=1, full=1) -> bytes:
    # cicpType: 'cicp' + reserved + 4 bytes: primaries, transfer, matrix, full-range flag
    body = b'cicp' + b'\x00\x00\x00\x00' + bytes([prim & 0xFF, trc & 0xFF, matrix & 0xFF, full & 0xFF])
    return pad4(body)


def build_min_icc_profile(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Build a small ICC v2 profile with a few tags: desc, wtpt, optionally text and cicp
    tags = []
    # Tag data blocks will be appended after tag table; we compute offsets accordingly.
    desc_texts = [
        'sRGB IEC61966-2.1',
        'Generic RGB Profile',
        'LittleCMS Test Profile',
        'Display Profile',
    ]
    name = rng.choice(desc_texts)
    desc = make_desc_tag(name)
    tags.append((b'desc', desc))

    wtpt = make_wtpt_tag()
    tags.append((b'wtpt', wtpt))

    if rng.random() < 0.6:
        txt = make_text_tag('Copyright (c) LCMS Generator')
        tags.append((b'cprt', txt))

    if rng.random() < 0.4:
        cicp = make_cicp_tag(prim=rng.randrange(1, 10), trc=rng.randrange(1, 16), matrix=rng.randrange(0, 3), full=rng.randrange(0, 2))
        tags.append((b'cicp', cicp))

    # Header (128 bytes)
    header = bytearray(128)
    # size will be filled later
    # cmmId (arbitrary)
    header[4:8] = b'lcms'
    # version v2.4.0 (0x02400000)
    header[8:12] = be32(0x02400000)
    # deviceClass: display 'mntr'
    header[12:16] = b'mntr'
    # colorSpace: RGB 'RGB '
    header[16:20] = b'RGB '
    # pcs: XYZ 'XYZ '
    header[20:24] = b'XYZ '
    # dateTime
    # Use a plausible date
    year = rng.randint(2000, 2025)
    dt = be16(year) + be16(rng.randint(1, 12)) + be16(rng.randint(1, 28)) + be16(rng.randint(0, 23)) + be16(rng.randint(0, 59)) + be16(rng.randint(0, 59))
    header[24:36] = dt
    # magic 'acsp'
    header[36:40] = be32(ICC_MAGIC)
    # platform 'MSFT'
    header[40:44] = b'MSFT'
    # flags
    header[44:48] = be32(0)
    # manufacturer (arbitrary)
    header[48:52] = b'lcms'
    # model
    header[52:56] = be32(0)
    # attributes (64-bit), set to 0
    header[56:64] = b'\x00' * 8
    # rendering intent (0 perceptual)
    header[64:68] = be32(0)
    # illuminant XYZ (D50)
    header[68:80] = be_s15f16(0.9642) + be_s15f16(1.0000) + be_s15f16(0.8249)
    # creator
    header[80:84] = b'lcms'
    # profile ID (MD5) zero
    header[84:100] = b'\x00' * 16
    # reserved
    header[100:128] = b'\x00' * 28

    # Tag count and entries
    tag_count = len(tags)
    tag_table = bytearray()
    tag_table += be32(tag_count)

    # Compute offsets: after header + tag table (12 bytes per entry)
    table_bytes = 4 + tag_count * 12
    current_offset = 128 + table_bytes

    data_blocks = bytearray()
    entries = []
    for sig, data in tags:
        data = pad4(data)
        size = len(data)
        entries.append((sig, current_offset, size))
        data_blocks += data
        current_offset += size

    for sig, off, size in entries:
        tag_table += sig + be32(off) + be32(size)

    profile = bytearray()
    profile += header
    profile += tag_table
    profile += data_blocks

    # Update total size in header
    total_size = len(profile)
    profile[0:4] = be32(total_size)

    # Ensure size <= 4096; if exceeded, trim optional tags by rebuilding without extras
    if total_size > 4096:
        # Rebuild with only desc + wtpt
        tags2 = [(b'desc', desc), (b'wtpt', wtpt)]
        return build_min_icc_profile_with_tags(rng, tags2)

    return bytes(profile)


def build_min_icc_profile_with_tags(rng: random.Random, tags):
    # Helper if we need to restrict tag set
    header = bytearray(128)
    header[4:8] = b'lcms'
    header[8:12] = be32(0x02400000)
    header[12:16] = b'mntr'
    header[16:20] = b'RGB '
    header[20:24] = b'XYZ '

    header[40:44] = b'MSFT'
    header[44:48] = be32(0)
    header[48:52] = b'lcms'

    header[64:68] = be32(0)
    header[68:80] = be_s15f16(0.9642) + be_s15f16(1.0) + be_s15f16(0.8249)
    header[80:84] = b'lcms'

    header[100:128] = b'\x00' * 28

    tag_table += be32(tag_count)
    table_bytes = 4 + tag_count * 12
